2517899.long: Andersen, who signed a one-year, $1 million contract with Edmonton in July, is still rehabbing from a knee injury. He posted a 16-14-5 record with a 3.05 GAA and an .874 save percentage in 35 appearances for Carolina during the 2025-26 regular season. Once he's ready to play in the 2026-27 campaign with the Oilers, Andersen could compete for starts with Tristan Jarry and Devon Levi.
2517899.name: Frederik Andersen
2517899.short: Andersen (knee) isn't expected back until "maybe" December, head coach Mike Babcock told NHL.com on Tuesday.

2558631.long: Ekholm was hurt on a hit by William Carrier in the third period of Thursday's game. For now, Shakir Mukhamadullin will fill in on the third pairing while Jake Walman will pick up some top-four usage. However, the Oilers' defense has been a little shaky to start the season, so a roster move could still be in order.
2558631.name: Mattias Ekholm
2558631.short: Ekholm (undisclosed) will miss at least a week after getting injured versus the Hurricanes on Thursday, Jason Gregor of Sports 1440 Edmonton reports.

2562606.long: Huberdeau played well in his first career AHL game. The 33-year-old is wrapping up the rehab process for his hip surgery. He can spend up to two weeks with the Wranglers on this conditioning loan, but if he continues to play well, he may not need the full amount of time before he's ready for his NHL season debut.
2562606.name: Jonathan Huberdeau
2562606.short: Huberdeau (hip) had three assists in AHL Calgary's 4-3 win over Coachella Valley on Wednesday.

2562622.long: Namestnikov has an assist in six outings in 2026-27. Brad Lambert is likely to draw into the lineup due to Namestnikov's absence.
2562622.name: Vladislav Namestnikov
2562622.short: Namestnikov (undisclosed) won't play Thursday versus Winnipeg, per Mitchell Clinton of the Jets' official site.

2562624.long: Even though he has received clearance to play, he isn't expected to suit up for Sunday's matchup against St. Louis. He has already missed the last four games, including Saturday's 7-4 loss to Carolina.
2562624.name: Ryan Nugent-Hopkins
2562624.short: Nugent-Hopkins (undisclosed) is slated to return to the lineup against Vegas on Tuesday, Paige Martin of Oilers TV reports.

2563034.long: Edmundson has generated four points in 21 games this season, putting him on track for a third straight 20-point campaign. If the blueliner were to miss out Monday, Cody Ceci would step into the lineup in his stead, especially if Erik Gustafsson (upper body), who is also a game-time call, is ruled out as well.
2563034.name: Joel Edmundson
2563034.short: Edmundson will be a game-time call against Montreal on Monday due to an undisclosed injury, Zach Dooley of the Kings' official site reports.

2590824.long: Gibson sustained a lower-body injury during Tuesday's game against the Lightning, and he was unavailable for Thursday's matchup against the Golden Knights. It's not yet clear whether Gibson will be able to suit up for Saturday's road game against Colorado, but he doesn't appear to be facing a long-term absence.
2590824.name: John Gibson
2590824.short: Gibson (lower body) participated in Friday's practice session, Helene St. James of the Detroit Free Press reports.

2590829.long: Manson has a goal, four points, two PIM, 28 hits and 17 blocks in 13 appearances with Colorado in 2026-27. He's been serving primarily in a third-pairing role. Noah Juulsen might play regularly during Manson's absence.
2590829.name: Josh Manson
2590829.short: Manson (ankle) is expected to miss the next eight weeks, Corey Masisak of The Denver Post reports Friday.

2590861.long: DeMelo has already been placed on injured reserve, but this latest update provides a clearer recovery timeline. The blueliner hasn't scored a goal since Opening Night versus Boston, a stretch of 19 games without finding the back of the net. During that stretch, DeMelo did chip in seven helpers, 27 hits and 22 blocks, giving him decent category coverage in banger formats.
2590861.name: Dylan DeMelo
2590861.short: DeMelo (lower body) is expected to be out of action for 4-6 weeks, Mitchell Clinton of the Jets' official site reports Thursday.

2591155.long: Rust has been out of action for the Penguins' last 11 contests due to his lower-body injury. When healthy, the 34-year-old winger has played in seven contests in which he has notched three goals and two assists, including a pair of power-play points.
2591155.name: Bryan Rust
2591155.short: Rust (lower body) is skating in a non-contact sweater Friday, Seth Rorabaugh of Tribune-Review Sports reports.

2593131.long: Pageau has missed the last three games due to his lower-body problem, but he could get back into action Thursday. If Pageau does suit up, it will likely be in a fourth-line role, which could make it difficult for him to break out of his 12-game goalless streak.
2593131.name: Jean-Gabriel Pageau
2593131.short: Pageau (lower body) will be a game-time call against the Jets on Thursday, Andrew Gross of Newsday reports.

2593315.long: After missing the first nine games of the season while recovering from sports hernia surgery, Zucker has been trending in the right direction recently, and his return to game action appears to be imminent. Across 62 regular-season appearances with Buffalo last year, he recorded 24 goals, 21 assists, 57 hits, 23 PIM and 21 blocked shots while averaging 15:37 of ice time.
2593315.name: Jason Zucker
2593315.short: Zucker (abdomen) practiced on the third line Monday and is on track to make his regular-season debut Wednesday against the Flyers.

2952729.long: Krug's move to long-term injured reserve was partially a financial decision, as it allows the Blues to exceed the salary cap by $4 million. The 35-year-old blueliner hasn't played since the 2023-24 campaign, but he hasn't officially ruled out a return. Regardless of when he decides to hang up his skates, the 13-year NHL veteran will be remembered as an excellent two-way player, as he currently sits at 483 points, 621 hits and 832 blocked shots across 778 regular-season outings.
2952729.name: Torey Krug
2952729.short: Krug (ankle) was placed on long-term injured reserve by the Blues on Monday, per PuckPedia.

2968829.long: Girgensons will miss his second straight game, but he might be ready to return against Carolina on Wednesday. He has contributed one goal, three assists, 26 shots on net, 15 blocked shots and 56 hits in 18 appearances this season.
2968829.name: Zemgus Girgensons
2968829.short: Girgensons (upper body) won't play against Buffalo on Sunday, per Benjamin Pierce of the Lightning's official site.

2976833.long: Rielly is slated to miss his second consecutive contest with a lower-body injury, which he sustained in Saturday's contest against Montreal. Prior to the injury, the 32-year-old blueliner posted 12 assists, 21 shots on net, eight hits and 23 blocked shots over 18 appearances. In his absence, Dakota Mermis will likely see a heightened role again Tuesday. Rielly's next chance to return is Thursday's home game against the Wild.
2976833.name: Morgan Rielly
2976833.short: Rielly (lower body) has been deemed day-to-day and will not play in Tuesday's home clash against the Avalanche, per David Alter of The Hockey News.

2976842.long: Faksa will miss his second straight game against New Jersey on Tuesday and is probably still about a week away from returning. He has chipped in one assist, nine shots on net, nine blocked shots and 12 hits in 10 outings this campaign.
2976842.name: Radek Faksa
2976842.short: Faksa (lower body) will likely miss another week, according to Owen Newkirk of DLLS Sports on Tuesday.

2976849.long: Jankowski will miss his fifth straight game with a lower-body injury, but he is expected to rejoin his teammates for Tuesday's morning skate. He has contributed six goals, one assist, 15 shots on net, six hits and four blocked shots in nine appearances this season.
2976849.name: Mark Jankowski
2976849.short: Jankowski (lower body) won't play against Boston on Tuesday, per Ryan Henkel of The Hockey News.

2976850.long: Maatta missed his second straight game Sunday against Columbus and doesn't have a clear timeline for a return to game action. The left-shot blueliner didn't practice Saturday, so he might not be that close to suiting up in a game, but it's at least positive that he will travel with the team. Minnesota's road trip begins Tuesday in Edmonton and concludes Oct. 27 in Utah.
2976850.name: Olli Maatta
2976850.short: Maatta (upper body) will be on the Wild's upcoming five-game road trip, according to Michael Russo of The Athletic on Sunday.

2976851.long: Matheson has already been out of action for the last six games due to his lower-body injury, so his move to LTIR will only cost him an additional four games, which he was likely to miss anyway based on his recovery timeline. With the available cap space, the Habs recalled Brett Berard and David Reinbacher from the minors.
2976851.name: Mike Matheson
2976851.short: Matheson (lower body) was placed on long-term injured reserve Tuesday, Renaud Lavoie of TVA Sports reports.

2992930.long: MacDermid doesn't have a timeline for his return. He contributed one assist, four shots on goal, 18 hits and 33 PIM in 19 appearances for Ottawa during the 2025-26 regular season.
2992930.name: Kurtis MacDermid
2992930.short: MacDermid (upper body) was moved to the injured non-roster list Monday.

2993474.long: Sissons still needs to be cleared for contact, but he will participate in Sunday's practice. He has missed the last six games, but he has been making progress in his recovery. Sissons has two goals, six points, 19 shots on net, 38 hits and 11 blocked shots in 19 appearances this season.
2993474.name: Colton Sissons
2993474.short: Sissons (lower body) is day-to-day, per David Alter of The Hockey News on Sunday.

3020225.long: While Hellebuyck appears to be close to making his team debut, Keefe said that there are "several boxes they'll need to tick" before the Devils officially give the green light to their new netminder. If Hellebuyck is held out during New Jersey's back-to-back set that includes a game against Dallas on Tuesday and a matchup against Colorado on Wednesday, Jake Allen and Remi Poirier would likely handle goaltending duties for the Devils.
3020225.name: Connor Hellebuyck
3020225.short: Head coach Sheldon Keefe said Monday that Hellebuyck (not injury related) intends to play during the Devils' upcoming three-game road trip, Amanda Stein of the Devils' official site reports.

3024798.long: The Mammoth indicated Monday that Schmidt was considered out indefinitely, and he was officially placed on injured reserve. It isn't particularly surprising to see him labeled as week-to-week, and it indicates that he's unlikely to return after spending the minimum amount of time on IR. It seems likely that the 35-year-old will be sidelined until at least late November.
3024798.name: Nate Schmidt
3024798.short: The Mammoth announced Thursday that Schmidt (upper body) is considered week-to-week, Cole Bagley of KSL Sports reports.

3025535.long: Pesce will miss his second straight game. He has recorded one goal, seven assists, 19 shots on net, 32 blocked shots and six hits in 19 appearances this season. Pesce has some extra time to recover ahead of Wednesday's matchup against Montreal, but it's unclear if he will be ready to return to the lineup by then.
3025535.name: Brett Pesce
3025535.short: Pesce (illness) won't play against Washington on Saturday, Amanda Stein of the Devils' official site reports.

3041969.long: MacKinnon wouldn't be ready until mid-February if that timetable proves to be accurate. It can't be overstated how important MacKinnon is to the Avalanche. He finished each of the previous four regular seasons with over 110 points, and he was well on his way towards another elite campaign after scoring 10 goals and 30 points through 20 appearances. Brock Nelson and Nazem Kadri are serving as the Avalanche's top two centers while MacKinnon is unavailable.
3041969.name: Nathan MacKinnon
3041969.short: MacKinnon (lower body) has been evaluated by a specialist and is expected to miss the next 12 weeks, Aarif Deen of Colorado Hockey Now reports Saturday.

3041970.long: Barkov has appeared in only two games this season and hasn't played since Oct. 1. However, he is close to returning to the lineup. Once activated by the Panthers from long-term injured reserve, Barkov should occupy a top-six role while seeing time on the power play and penalty kill.
3041970.name: Aleksander Barkov
3041970.short: Barkov (knee) won't play against Buffalo on Saturday, but he could return within Florida's next three games, Jameson Olive of the Panthers' official site reports.

3041995.long: Compher hasn't played since Oct. 4 because of the injury. He'll need to be activated off injured reserve first, but if Compher ends up playing Thursday, then he will likely serve in a middle-six capacity, while Sheldon Dries might be a healthy scratch after playing in Detroit's past six games.
3041995.name: J.T. Compher
3041995.short: Compher (undisclosed) has a "real good chance" of playing against Vancouver on Thursday, head coach Todd McLellan told Max Bultman of The Athletic.

3041997.long: Nurse will have to miss at least one game after getting hurt in a fight Tuesday versus the Bruins. Nolan Allan is expected to take Nurse's place in the lineup. The Sharks' road trip continues Saturday in Detroit, and Nurse will likely be a game-time decision leading up to that game.
3041997.name: Darnell Nurse
3041997.short: Nurse (upper body) wasn't on the ice for warmups, indicating he'll miss Thursday's game versus the Predators, Sheng Peng of San Jose Hockey Now reports.

3041999.long: Ristolainen's placement on injured reserve was expected after head coach Rick Tocchet announced that the 32-year-old blueliner would miss roughly two weeks. Ristolainen had already missed nine games due to the same hand issue earlier in the season, but the injury flared back up in Saturday's clash against the Ducks. When healthy, he's been solid with a goal, five shots on net, seven hits and seven blocked shots across four appearances this season. In his absence, Cam York has been activated off injured reserve and should take on some of the minutes vacated by Ristolainen.
3041999.name: Rasmus Ristolainen
3041999.short: Ristolainen (hand) was placed on injured reserve, retroactive to Oct. 24, on Tuesday.

3042014.long: There's no timetable for Domi's return after he had complications while undergoing surgery over the summer. The 31-year-old had 12 goals, 36 points and 95 PIM in 80 regular-season appearances with Toronto in 2025-26. Domi will likely serve in a middle-six capacity once he's ready to return.
3042014.name: Max Domi
3042014.short: Domi (back) was transferred from the non-roster list to long-term injured reserve Wednesday, per PuckPedia.

3042016.long: Morrissey is close to returning, but he will miss his 14th straight game against the Lightning on Sunday. He has collected three assists, 12 shots on net, five blocked shots and one hit in four appearances this season. Morrissey will need to be activated from injured reserve once he's cleared to play.
3042016.name: Josh Morrissey
3042016.short: Morrissey (wrist) won't play against Tampa Bay on Sunday, Mike McIntyre of the Winnipeg Free Press reports.

3042019.long: Pulock has missed each of the Islanders' last two games due to a shoulder injury, which he suffered in Thursday's 4-3 loss to the Jets. Prior to going down, the 32-year-old blueliner posted four assists, a plus-7 rating, 15 shots on net, 12 hits and 30 blocked shots over 17 games this season. In his absence, expect Matt Kessel to see an increased role over the next seven to 14 days while Pulock recovers.
3042019.name: Ryan Pulock
3042019.short: Pulock (shoulder) is expected to miss 1-2 weeks, Andrew Gross of Newsday reports Tuesday.

3042037.long: After being placed on long-term injured reserve on Wednesday, Mantha underwent surgery Monday to repair a throat fracture. Prior to sustaining the injury, the 32-year-old winger posted five goals, 10 points, 21 shots on net and 11 hits over 17 appearances this season. In his absence, Amadeus Lombardi and Lenni Hameenaho will likely continue to serve as depth options in New Jersey's forward room.
3042037.name: Anthony Mantha
3042037.short: Mantha (neck) is expected to miss about one month after undergoing surgery, per Kristy Flannery of The Hockey News.

3042044.long: When exactly Burakovsky gets into the lineup isn't totally clear, but at least fantasy managers have a rough timeline to work with. In his eight outings this season, the 31-year-old winger has yet to register a point while producing just three shots, three hits and two PIM. Whenever Burakovsky does return, it figures to be in a bottom-six role.
3042044.name: Andre Burakovsky
3042044.short: Burakovsky (lower body) will be with the Senators for their four-game road trip and is expected to play at some point, Bruce Garrioch of Postmedia reports Wednesday.

3042048.long: McCarron's potential return could see Nico Sturm relegated to a spot in the press box against Montreal, though several players in the bottom-six could be in danger of being scratched. For his part, McCarron has notched three goals and five assists in 18 games while averaging 13:35 of ice time.
3042048.name: Michael McCarron
3042048.short: McCarron (upper body) could be an option versus the Canadiens on Tuesday, Joe Smith of The Athletic reports.

3042085.long: Janmark underwent an undisclosed procedure earlier in the year, but he's currently shelved until further notice. The 33-year-old winger was limited in 2025-26, where he compiled a goal and eight points across 43 regular-season outings. In his absence, Mathieu Joseph and Max Jones are expected to serve as the team's left wingers in the bottom six to open the 2026-27 campaign.
3042085.name: Mattias Janmark
3042085.short: Janmark (undisclosed) does not have a timetable for his return from injury.

3042095.long: Bjorkstrand landed on injured reserve Friday due to his upper-body injury, which has been revealed to keep him sidelined for the foreseeable future. Prior to going down, the 31-year-old winger compiled seven goals, 11 points, a plus-2 rating, 30 shots on net and 14 hits over 22 appearances. His current timetable for return should get him back in the mix around late January or early February. In the meantime, Matt Rempe will likely see more consistent playing time moving forward.
3042095.name: Oliver Bjorkstrand
3042095.short: Bjorkstrand (upper body) is expected to be sidelined for 2-3 months, Peter Baugh of The Athletic reports Saturday.

3042110.long: This move was necessary to create cap space for the activation of Dakota Joshua (abdomen) from LTIR. Wood has had no established timeline for a return, but he will be required to miss at least three more games.
3042110.name: Miles Wood
3042110.short: Wood (undisclosed) was transferred to long-term injured reserve Wednesday, David Alter of The Hockey News reports.

3042122.long: Graves will miss the beginning of the 2026-27 campaign, and it's unclear when he will be ready to return. He contributed one goal, 21 shots on net, 38 blocked shots and 23 hits in 22 regular-season appearances for Pittsburgh in 2025-26.
3042122.name: Ryan Graves
3042122.short: Graves (lower body) is out indefinitely and was placed on injured reserve Sunday.

3067822.long: Johnston has an assist, 17 PIM and 44 hits in 12 appearances with St. Louis in 2026-27. He also missed Tuesday's tilt against the Ducks because of the injury. Johnston is an option for the fourth line when he's available.
3067822.name: Ross Johnston
3067822.short: Johnston (upper body) will miss Thursday's game against Pittsburgh, per the NHL media site.

3069266.long: Korpisalo hasn't played yet this season because of the injury, so this is an opportunity for him to shake off the rust before playing for the Rangers. He's been making progress recently, including his participation in Friday's practice. While he didn't stay on for the full session, that was planned, per Vince Z. Mercogliano of The Athletic. When Korpisalo is ready to return, he'll have an opportunity to compete for the No. 1 spot. Igor Shesterkin (knee) hasn't played since Oct. 9 and won't return this campaign, which has resulted in the Rangers leaning heavily on Dylan Garand. James Reimer is also on the Rangers' roster, but the 38-year-old has stopped just five of eight shots across 20:00 of ice time since signing with New York on Oct. 25, so he hasn't been a major factor. It's possible Reimer will eventually lose his roster spot once Korpisalo is up to speed.
3069266.name: Joonas Korpisalo
3069266.short: Korpisalo (foot) was reassigned to AHL Hartford on Wednesday for a conditioning stint, Mollie Walker of the New York Post.

3069285.long: Ullmark will be sidelined for his eighth consecutive game due to his upper-body problem. Still, the fact that the 33-year-old netminder was on the ice for Friday's practice is a good indication he'll be back sooner rather than later. In the meantime, Samuel Ersson should continue to see the bulk of the workload.
3069285.name: Linus Ullmark
3069285.short: Ullmark (lower body) is not expected back for Saturday's clash with Utah, TSN 1200 Ottawa reports.

3069341.long: Head coach Jim Montgomery called Parayko's absence from practice Friday a maintenance day related to an upper-body issue that forced him to briefly exit Thursday's game against the Bruins. Montgomery said that Parayko will "probably" be able to play against Detroit, but the Blues will wait to see whether he's ready Saturday morning. If Parayko is unavailable, Montgomery said that the team feels comfortable inserting Quinton Burns into the lineup for his NHL debut.
3069341.name: Colton Parayko
3069341.short: Parayko didn't practice Friday due to an upper-body injury but is considered probable for Saturday's game against the Red Wings, Lou Korac of NHL.com reports.

3069352.long: Lindell has missed each of the Stars' last three games with a lower-body injury, but is seemingly nearing a return. When healthy, the 32-year-old blueliner has been solid this season, compiling a plus-4 rating, four shots on net, five hits and 18 blocked shots across nine games. Given his updated timeline for return, Lindell could be back as early as Saturday's home clash against the Blue Jackets.
3069352.name: Esa Lindell
3069352.short: Lindell (lower body) is expected to return to the Stars' lineup within the next 4-7 days, per Owen Newkirk of DLLS Sports.

3069448.long: Buffalo placed Grzelcyk on injured reserve Tuesday. He hasn't played since Opening Night against Columbus on Oct. 1. With Rasmus Dahlin (upper body) and Grzelcyk unavailable, the Sabres recalled Dennis Gilbert from AHL Rochester to play against Montreal on Tuesday.
3069448.name: Matt Grzelcyk
3069448.short: Grzelcyk (lower body) suffered a "flare-up" and could be out for at least "a few days," head coach Lindy Ruff told Rachel Lenzi of The Buffalo News on Tuesday.

3069687.long: The Canadiens moved Anderson to the injured reserve list Sunday after he logged a season-low 10:46 of ice time in Saturday's 4-1 loss to Colorado. He has contributed eight goals, 12 points, 35 shots on net and 42 hits in 19 appearances this season. With Anderson and Chris Kreider (lower body) dealing with long-term injuries, Florian Xhekaj and Owen Beck could see regular minutes in Montreal's bottom-six forward group.
3069687.name: Josh Anderson
3069687.short: Anderson (lower body) will be out for approximately 3-4 weeks, per Renaud Lavoie of TVA Sports on Sunday.

3094261.long: Tampa Bay's road trip includes stops in Minnesota, Winnipeg, Buffalo and Columbus on Saturday, Sunday, Wednesday and Thursday, respectively. Gourde hasn't played yet this campaign due to the injury. He had nine goals and 28 points in 82 regular-season appearances with Tampa Bay in 2025-26. Gourde will probably serve in a middle-six role once he's healthy.
3094261.name: Yanni Gourde
3094261.short: Gourde (hip) will miss Thursday's game against Chicago, but he might be available at some point during the upcoming four-game road trip, per Benjamin Pierce of the Lightning's official site.

3096186.long: Moore has already missed two games due to his undisclosed injury, but may not have to miss a third. The veteran winger has scored just once in his last seven outings while chipping in an assist. If Moore does play, it will likely be in a middle-six role that could come with some power-play ice time.
3096186.name: Trevor Moore
3096186.short: Moore (undisclosed) will be a game-time decision versus the Canadiens on Monday, Zach Dooley of the Kings' official site reports.

3096217.long: Demko missed the second half of the 2025-26 season after undergoing hip surgery in January, and he was officially placed on injured reserve last week. He doesn't yet have a clear timetable for when he'll be back in action, but Sedin said that Demko is "taking steps every day" in his recovery process. While Demko is sidelined, Kevin Lankinen and Leevi Merilainen should compete for starts in the Canucks' crease.
3096217.name: Thatcher Demko
3096217.short: Co-president of hockey operations Henrik Sedin said Monday that he hopes Demko (hip) will be ready to return before Christmas, Kevin Woodley of NHL.com reports.

3114741.long: Ehlers registered an assist, but he was also limited to 11:22 of ice time in Carolina's 7-4 win over Edmonton on Saturday. He has six goals and 22 points in 23 outings with the Hurricanes in 2026-27. Nicolas Deslauriers might draw into the lineup Sunday as a result of Ehlers' injury.
3114741.name: Nikolaj Ehlers
3114741.short: Ehlers (undisclosed) won't play Sunday against the Rangers, per Chip Alexander of The Raleigh News & Observer.

3114743.long: Fiala has been progressing in recent practices and is close to making his 2026-27 debut. He hasn't played since the 2026 Winter Olympics in February, when he suffered a lower-leg fracture while competing for Switzerland. Fiala registered 18 goals, 40 points, 147 shots on net, 24 blocked shots and 39 hits in 56 regular-season appearances with the Kings in 2025-26.
3114743.name: Kevin Fiala
3114743.short: Fiala (lower leg) should play Thursday against the Islanders or Saturday against Calgary, according to Emily Kaplan of ESPN.

3114755.long: After 818 regular-season outings across 12 seasons with the Red Wings, it appears that Larkin has suited up for Detroit for the last time. The 30-year-old center is expected to be traded in the near future after he recently made his 12-team trade list public. He initially put in a trade request in June, but ultimately remained with the Red Wings to start the new season, where he's compiled two goals, six points and 32 shots on net across 10 appearances. It remains to be seen which of the 12 teams on his trade list are pursuing the veteran center, but he can provide high-level two-way play up the center of the ice for the team that ultimately lands him. He's a strong player to stash in fantasy until his inevitable trade away from Motor City occurs.
3114755.name: Dylan Larkin
3114755.short: Larkin (not injury related) will not play until he is traded away from the Red Wings, per Elliotte Friedman of Sportsnet.

3114770.long: Schmaltz is poised to miss his second straight game after being injured in Wednesday's 5-3 loss to Vegas. The Mammoth expect to know more about his timeline soon. Schmaltz has nine goals, 20 points and 48 shots on net in 19 appearances this season.
3114770.name: Nick Schmaltz
3114770.short: Schmaltz (lower body) isn't expected to play against San Jose on Saturday, and it's unclear when he will be ready to return, Brogan Houston of the Deseret News reports.

3114777.long: McCann had one goal in five games before sitting out Saturday's 5-1 loss to Minnesota. He has earned five assists, eight points, 28 shots on net, three blocked shots and six hits in 11 appearances this season. With McCann unavailable, Kaapo Kakko moved up to the top line in Saturday's game.
3114777.name: Jared McCann
3114777.short: McCann (lower body) will be out for approximately 10 weeks, the team announced Sunday.

3114802.long: Kempe is day-to-day and will miss at least one game. He has earned three goals, eight points, 41 shots on net, 18 hits and three blocked shots in 12 appearances this season. With Kempe unavailable, Martin Chromiak will make his NHL debut against the Sabres on Saturday.
3114802.name: Adrian Kempe
3114802.short: Kempe (undisclosed) won't be in the lineup against Buffalo on Saturday, per Zach Dooley of the Kings' official site.

3115032.long: Montour missed Saturday's clash against his former team with the lower-body injury he suffered in Thursday's game against the Lightning. Prior to the injury, Montour posted an excellent start to the 2026-27 with five assists, 13 shots on net, seven hits and 13 blocked shots across eight appearances. If he's ultimately kept out of the lineup Tuesday, Cale Fleury would likely suit up in his spot once again.
3115032.name: Brandon Montour
3115032.short: Montour (lower body) is expected to be a game-time decision for Tuesday's home clash against the Red Wings, per Alison Lukan of the Kraken Hockey Network.

3124.long: Malkin has six goals and 11 points in 13 appearances in 2026-27. He missed Tuesday's game against Vegas due to the injury. Andrei Kuzmenko is projected to be a healthy scratch Thursday if Malkin is ready to return.
3124.name: Evgeni Malkin
3124.short: Malkin (lower body) took contact during Wednesday's practice, and he might be good to play Thursday versus Boston, per Wes Crosby of NHL.com.

3149619.long: Mangiapane hasn't played since Sept. 29 and is still on injured reserve. Based on the most recent report, he might not have a regular spot in the lineup when he's healthy. Mangiapane had eight goals and 16 points in 62 regular-season appearances with Edmonton and Chicago in 2025-26.
3149619.name: Andrew Mangiapane
3149619.short: Mangiapane (lower body) is likely to be available to play Friday, but he probably won't be in the lineup, CHGO Blackhawks reports.

3150479.long: Hodgson hasn't been skating and is expected to miss his fourth straight game against Calgary on Monday with a groin injury. has contributed one goal, three shots on net, 20 hits and 24 PIM in 10 appearances this season.
3150479.name: Hayden Hodgson
3150479.short: Hodgson (groin) has no timeline in place for his return to the lineup, per Bruce Garrioch of Postmedia on Nov. 14.

3151036.long: Foegele has been sidelined since late October, and he initially carried a return timetable of 3-4 weeks. While he hasn't yet entered that window, the fact that he hasn't yet resumed skating suggests that he isn't particularly close to returning to game action. A better idea of the 30-year-old's timetable to return will likely come into focus once he's cleared to return to the ice.
3151036.name: Warren Foegele
3151036.short: Head coach Travis Green said Monday that Foegele (knee) hasn't yet resumed skating, Bruce Garrioch of Postmedia reports.

3151038.long: Less than 24 hours after Merzlikins was traded to the Maple Leafs, a timetable for his return to action has been provided. The 32-year-old backstop had an up and down season in 2025-26, where he posted a 14-11-3 record, a 3.39 GAA and an .883 save percentage across 30 regular-season outings. He won't be rushed into action, as the Leafs new goaltender tandem of Sergei Bobrovsky and Anthony Stolarz are still expected to handle the majority of reps between the pipes this upcoming season. However, when Merzlikins is ready to return, he's the clear No. 3 option in Toronto's organization and could still see some playing time at the NHL level if he isn't sent down to AHL Toronto.
3151038.name: Elvis Merzlikins
3151038.short: Merzlikins is expected to miss 4-6 months to begin the 2026-27 regular season while recovering from a shoulder injury, per Luke Fox of Sportsnet.

3151136.long: The Oilers seem to want to see how Walman fares during Saturday's morning skate before officially giving him the green light to suit up against Utah, but he appears poised to put an end to his three-game absence due to an upper-body injury. Across his four appearances to begin the regular season, the 30-year-old has been held scoreless with seven blocked shots, five shots on goal and four PIM while averaging 14:47 of ice time.
3151136.name: Jake Walman
3151136.short: Walman (upper body) will likely play in Saturday's game against the Mammoth, Jason Gregor of Sports 1440 Edmonton reports.

3151297.long: Shesterkin was hurt during Friday's game against the Capitals when his right leg got jammed into the post while returning to the crease on a scrambled play, and the Rangers ruled him out for the season a day later. He was placed on injured reserve Sunday, and the team has now provided some clarification on the exact nature of his injury. Dylan Garand is slated to serve as the Rangers' No. 1 option in the crease until Joonas Korpisalo (lower body) is back in action.
3151297.name: Igor Shesterkin
3151297.short: Shesterkin will require surgery and a lengthy rehab process to address his season-ending right knee injury, Vince Z. Mercogliano of The Athletic reports Sunday.

3535.long: Foligno has been sidelined for the Wild's last 14 games and will be out for at least one more when the team squares off with San Jose on Friday. In the 39-year-old winger's three games, he generated one goal, three shots and a plus-two rating while averaging just 9:57 of ice time.
3535.name: Nick Foligno
3535.short: Foligno (upper body) might be available to face the Lightning on Saturday, Michael Russo of The Athletic reports.

3541.long: Staal looks poised to get back into the lineup for the first time since Oct. 10 versus the Blackhawks. Prior to getting hurt, the veteran center was struggling offensively, with zero points in six games while producing six shots, 19 hits and three blocks. In addition to his five-on-five role, Staal will likely be in the mix for power-play ice time.
3541.name: Jordan Staal
3541.short: Staal (calf) will be a game-time decision versus the Kraken on Saturday after head coach Rod Brind'Amour told reporters, "So, we'll find out probably tomorrow after you know gets through the morning, and hopefully he does play," per Tom Gulitti of NHL.com.

3648008.long: Rodrigues missed Monday's practice due to an illness. If he can't play against the Oilers on Tuesday, New Jersey may dress seven blueliners or recall a forward from the minors. Rodrigues has two goals, five points, 17 shots on net, five blocked shots and 20 hits in 14 appearances this season.
3648008.name: Evan Rodrigues
3648008.short: Rodrigues (illness) is questionable for Tuesday's matchup against Edmonton, per Amanda Stein of the Devils' official site.

3648015.long: Greer suffered an upper-body injury in Sunday's 6-3 win over Ottawa. He will miss at least the next four games, starting with Tuesday's matchup against Vancouver, but it's unclear when he will be ready to return. Greer has four goals, six points, 23 shots on net and 36 hits in 13 appearances this season.
3648015.name: A.J. Greer
3648015.short: Greer (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Monday.

3654006.long: After suffering an injury setback in mid-October, Lyon appears to be trending towards a return in the near future. He's expected to travel with the Sabres' during their upcoming six-game road trip, and given the amount of time away from home, he could make his return by the end of it. Lyon has a strong campaign during the 2025-26 regular season, where he compiled a 20-10-4 record, a 2.77 GAA, three shutouts and a .906 save percentage across 36 outings. For the time being, Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen and Colten Ellis will continue to defend the Sabres' net.
3654006.name: Alex Lyon
3654006.short: Lyon (shoulder) will travel with the Sabres during the team's upcoming road trip, per Heather Engel of NHL.com.

3735.long: Kane seems unlikely to miss the opportunity to play in front of his hometown, but fantasy managers will need to wait until he is activated off injured reserve for final confirmation. If, as expected, Kane does suit up Tuesday, he figures to replace Teuvo Teravainen on the second line as well as on the No. 1 power-play unit. The 37-year-old Kane is currently mired in a 14-game goalless streak dating back to the season opener Sept. 29 against the Golden Knights.
3735.name: Patrick Kane
3735.short: Kane (upper body) will likely be in the lineup versus Buffalo on Thursday, Mark Lazerus of The Athletic reports.

3797.long: After missing the last two games with an upper-body injury, Backlund appears to be on track to play against the Maple Leafs. He returned to his regular top-line role during Monday's morning skate and went through his normal game-day routine. Backlund has earned one goal, two points, 24 shots on net, three blocked shots and seven hits in eight appearances this season.
3797.name: Mikael Backlund
3797.short: Backlund (upper body) will be a game-time decision against Toronto on Monday, per Pat Steinberg of QR Calgary 770 AM.

3852.long: Marchand is slightly behind Aleksander Barkov (knee) in terms of his potential return date. Barkov should be back in the fold within the next three games, per head coach Paul Maurice on Saturday. The 38-year-old Marchand has appeared in only two games this season and hasn't been in the lineup since Oct. 6 against the Kings.
3852.name: Brad Marchand
3852.short: Marchand (knee) is close to returning to the lineup, but he won't play against Buffalo on Saturday, per Jameson Olive of the Panthers' official site.

3870.long: After seemingly getting the hook due to early struggles in his Rangers debut Monday, it appears that Reimer sustained an injury in the contest, which likely played a part in the team's decision to pull him after the first period. He made five saves on eight attempts Monday, but wasn't credited with the loss due to the Kings' offense going off in a 6-3 win. Reimer is the third goalie for the Rangers to suffer an injury this season. However, the team doesn't play again until Sunday, meaning that he might not miss any time. If he can't go in New York's next clash, Spencer Martin will likely be called up to serve as the backup.
3870.name: James Reimer
3870.short: Reimer (upper body) was tagged as day-to-day Tuesday, per Vince Z. Mercogliano of The Athletic.

3891922.long: Gustafsson will miss at least the next three games, starting with Monday's matchup against Montreal, after landing on injured reserve. He suffered an upper-body injury in Saturday's 4-2 loss to Ottawa. Gustafsson has two goals, nine points, 16 shots on net and 16 blocked shots in 16 appearances this season.
3891922.name: Erik Gustafsson
3891922.short: Gustafsson (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Monday, per the NHL media site.

3891952.long: Panarin isn't with the Kings to begin their five-game road trip, but he's slated to return to action with three matchups remaining in the trip. Across 17 appearances this season, the 35-year-old has recorded eight goals, 11 assists, 14 PIM, six hits and three blocked shots while averaging 21:27 of ice time.
3891952.name: Artemi Panarin
3891952.short: Panarin (personal), who has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Maple Leafs, is expected to return Saturday against the Senators, John Hoven of SiriusXM NHL Network Radio reports.

3899946.long: The fact that Barzal is traveling with the team was good news to begin with, but it seems the veteran will be back sooner rather than later. In 81 regular-season games last year, the British Columbia native game up just one tally shy of the 20-goal mark, tallying 19 goals and 53 helpers, including 20 power-play points. With his lengthy absence, Barzal is unlikely to repeat that level of production in 2026-27.
3899946.name: Mathew Barzal
3899946.short: Barzal (knee) won't be in the lineup against the Sharks on Monday but has been upgraded to day-to-day, Andrew Gross of Newsday reports.

3899949.long: Zacha missed Saturday's game against the Kings due to an upper-body injury he sustained against Anaheim on Friday. It's not yet clear whether he'll be able to suit up Tuesday, but a better idea of his status could come into focus based on his participation in morning skate, though the medical staff will likely also see how he feels afterward before determining his availability. Across his first eight appearances of the regular season, Zacha has recorded two goals, three assists, five blocked shots, four hits and four PIM while averaging 18:05 of ice time.
3899949.name: Pavel Zacha
3899949.short: Zacha (upper body) is considered a game-time decision for Tuesday's matchup against Dallas, Adam Pellerin of NESN reports.

3900169.long: Konecny sat out Saturday's 5-1 loss to Boston and will miss additional time after moving to the IR list. It's unclear when he will be ready to return to the lineup, but he won't be an option for at least the next three games, starting with Sunday's matchup against Carolina.
3900169.name: Travis Konecny
3900169.short: Konecny (lower body) was placed on injured reserve Sunday, according to the NHL media site.

3900219.long: While Chabot was a full participant in Monday's practice, Garrioch noted that the 29-year-old skated on an extra defensive pairing, so a decision on his availability for Tuesday's game against the Golden Knights won't be made until after the morning skate. Regarding Chabot's outlook going forward, head coach Travis Green said, "I'm not sure if he's going to go tomorrow, but he's definitely close to playing. We'll see." If he ends up sitting out Tuesday, Chabot's next opportunity to return to the lineup will be in Los Angeles on Thursday.
3900219.name: Thomas Chabot
3900219.short: Chabot (upper body) was a full participant in Monday's practice in Vegas and is nearing a return to the lineup, according to Bruce Garrioch of Postmedia.

3904098.long: Roslovic has an assist in three straight games while also being stuck in a five-game goal drought. In 24 outings this year, the 29-year-old winger has been producing offensively, with nine goals and 14 helpers. If Roslovic does get into the lineup, it could be in a middle-six role, where he should offer decent offensive upside.
3904098.name: Jack Roslovic
3904098.short: Roslovic (upper body) will be a game-time decision versus the Islanders on Monday after head coach Jim Hiller told reporters, "You'll just see tonight. I don't want to get too deep into that right now," Mark Masters of TSN reports.

3904178.long: Cernak was sidelined for the Bolts' last two games due to his upper-body problem but seems close to making a return. The 29-year-old defenseman has yet to score a goal in 17 games this season, though that shouldn't come as a huge surprise considering his career-high is five. Still, Cernak should be capable of reaching the 20-point threshold and offers decent category coverage in banger formats.
3904178.name: Erik Cernak
3904178.short: Cernak (upper body) is considered a game-time decision ahead of Tuesday's matchup with Washington, per NHL.com.

3904183.long: While no official reason was given, it likely stems from Hintz's fight with Nathan MacKinnon. Hintz was seen icing his hand in the penalty box after the fight, though he was able to finish the contest. Check back in prior to Wednesday's rematch against the Avalanche to confirm Hintz's availability for that game.
3904183.name: Roope Hintz
3904183.short: Hintz (undisclosed) was unavailable to speak to the media after Tuesday's game versus the Avalanche, Lia Assimakopoulos of The Dallas Morning News reports.

3904188.long: Trenin missed Thursday's game against Calgary for personal reasons. He might rejoin the lineup Saturday, but that hasn't been confirmed. Trenin has four assists, six PIM and 102 hits in 23 appearances this campaign. Nico Sturm might be a healthy scratch against Vancouver if Trenin is an option.
3904188.name: Yakov Trenin
3904188.short: Trenin (personal) is expected to meet up with the Wild in Vancouver ahead of Saturday's game versus the Canucks, per Michael Russo of The Athletic.

3904190.long: With Siegenthaler's status uncertain, Vladislav Kolyachonok will take the warm-up and will slot into the lineup if Siegenthaler can't play. For his part, the 29-year-old defenseman has yet to find the back of the net this season, which doesn't come as a huge surprise considering he failed to score a goal in 82 regular-season games last year, though he did chip in 16 helpers over that stretch.
3904190.name: Jonas Siegenthaler
3904190.short: Siegenthaler is dealing with an illness that could put his availability against the Habs on Wednesday in doubt, Amanda Stein of the Devils' official site reports.

3939716.long: Dallas also recalled Kyle Burroughs from AHL Texas on Saturday and placed Lian Bichsel (lower body) on injured reserve. Capobianco hasn't played since Oct. 27 against New Jersey. He hasn't earned a point in five appearances this season, but he has registered three shots on net, three blocked shots and two hits.
3939716.name: Kyle Capobianco
3939716.short: Capobianco (leg) was moved to long-term injured reserve Saturday.

3941973.long: Cirelli was rolling offensively prior to getting hurt, racking up four goals and seven assists in his last 10 outings, including three multi-point efforts. If given the all-clear Tuesday, the 29-year-old center figures to slot back into a second-line role and should see time with the man advantage.
3941973.name: Anthony Cirelli
3941973.short: Cirelli (lower body) will be a game-time decision for Tuesday's clash with the Capitals, per NHL.com.

3941974.long: Marino remains day-to-day and has been skating, but he isn't quite ready to return to the lineup. He will miss his 16th straight game against Winnipeg on Monday. Once he receives clearance to play, Marino will need to be activated from injured reserve.
3941974.name: John Marino
3941974.short: Marino (upper body) likely won't return during Utah's four-game road trip, per Brogan Houston of the Deseret News on Monday.

3942043.long: McLellan's news is encouraging for Appleton, who was placed on injured reserve following the Red Wings' second game of the season. He was first seen skating in a non-contact jersey on Friday, and has been progressing without any reported setbacks since then. Prior to going down, the 30-year-old winger compiled six hits across his two appearances. Once he's ready to return, he'll likely slot into a role on the team's fourth line. Appleton's first chance to return on the team's upcoming four-game road trip is Saturday against the Avalanche.
3942043.name: Mason Appleton
3942043.short: Head coach Todd McLellan stated that Appleton (undisclosed) is expected to return to the lineup during the Red Wings' upcoming four-game road trip, per Max Bultman of The Athletic.

3942714.long: Montembeault hasn't yet appeared in a regular-season game during the 2026-27 campaign, as he sustained a lower-body injury during practice in early October and has been on injured reserve since then. The Canadiens indicated in late October that the netminder had been upgraded to day-to-day, but it's not yet clear when he'll be able to make his season debut. After making a career-high 62 regular-season appearances for Montreal during the 2024-25 campaign, the 30-year-old went 10-8-4 with a 3.43 GAA and .872 save percentage across 25 regular-season outings with the Canadiens last year. The Red Wings already have John Gibson and Daniil Tarasov in the crease, but Gibson hasn't been particularly sharp early in the year, so Montembeault will likely have an opportunity to compete for playing time once he's healthy.
3942714.name: Sam Montembeault
3942714.short: Montembeault (lower body), Kirby Dach, Michael Hage, a 2027 first-round pick, a 2029 first-round pick, a 2027 second-round pick and a 2028 fourth-round pick were traded to the Red Wings from the Canadiens on Sunday in exchange for Dylan Larkin, a 2028 second-round pick and a 2027 third-round pick.

3942905.long: The Ducks will need to activate Terry from long-term injured reserve to make it official, but the 29-year-old forward appears to be on track to play for the first time this campaign. During Tuesday's practice, he skated on the third line and occupied a spot on the second power-play unit. It has been a lengthy recovery process after he had offseason hip surgery. Terry collected 19 goals, 57 points and 161 shots on net in 61 regular-season appearances for Anaheim in 2025-26.
3942905.name: Troy Terry
3942905.short: Terry (hip) will likely make his 2026-27 debut against Nashville on Wednesday, according to Eric Stephens of The Athletic.

3942924.long: After missing the last six games due to a lower-body injury, Roy returned to Washington's top defense pairing in Monday's practice. He hasn't earned a point in two appearances this season, but he has registered five hits and five blocked shots. If Roy is ready for Tuesday's matchup against the Kings, the Capitals will need to activate the 31-year-old blueliner from injured reserve.
3942924.name: Matt Roy
3942924.short: Roy (lower body) could return to the lineup as early as Tuesday against the Kings, Tarik El-Bashir of Monumental Sports Network reports.

3943996.long: Roy also missed Colorado's past four games. He has two goals and four points in six appearances this campaign. When Roy is ready to return, he will likely serve in a bottom-six role.
3943996.name: Nicolas Roy
3943996.short: Roy (lower body) is expected to miss Friday's game against Tampa Bay, per Aarif Deen of Colorado Hockey Now.

3988782.long: O'Connor will get Saturday's clash off as he continues to mourn the loss of his father, Myles. The 30-year-old winger was recently given the all clear from his lower-body injury and has played in three games this season. In his absence Saturday, Gavin Brindley will take his spot on the team's fourth line. Expect O'Connor to have a solid chance to play in Monday's road clash against the Blackhawks.
3988782.name: Logan O'Connor
3988782.short: O'Connor (personal) will not play in Saturday's home clash against the Flames, per Corey Masisak of The Denver Post.

4024833.long: Dubois has missed the last five games due to his illness, but his return to action appears to be imminent. The Capitals returned Jonny Brodzinski to AHL Hershey on Wednesday, and Dubois' participation level in Wednesday's practice suggests that he's slated to return Saturday. Across his first four regular-season appearances this year, Dubois has recorded a goal, three assists, six PIM, five hits and three blocked shots while averaging 17:06 of ice time.
4024833.name: Pierre-Luc Dubois
4024833.short: Dubois (illness) skated Wednesday in a regular jersey and appears to be on track to return to game action Saturday against the Sabres, Sammi Silber of The Hockey News reports.

4024968.long: Stanley was injured versus the Ducks on Saturday, logging just 9:25 of ice time before being forced out of the game. The 28-year-old blueliner has yet to find the back of the net this season and is currently mired in a nine-game pointless streak. If Stanley can't play against Columbus, Scott Mayfield would be the most likely candidate to step into the lineup, though Matt Kessel could also be in contention.
4024968.name: Logan Stanley
4024968.short: Stanley (lower body) is considered day-to-day ahead of Tuesday's clash with the Blue Jackets, Andrew Gross of Newsday reports.

4031645.long: Carcone logged only 9:58 of ice time in Saturday's 3-2 win over Anaheim. The 30-year-old forward recently underwent surgery for an upper-body injury, according to Ken Wiebe of The Winnipeg Free Press. Carcone has chipped in one goal, three points, 30 shots on net and 38 hits in 15 appearances this season.
4031645.name: Michael Carcone
4031645.short: Carcone (upper body) will be out of action for 3-4 months, Catherine Bogart of the Mammoth's official site reports Monday.

4063401.long: Girard has missed each of the last three games with an undisclosed injury. It appears that he has a chance to play Thursday, but the Penguins would need to activate him from injured reserve prior to the contest if he's to appear in the lineup. Prior to going down with the injury, the 28-year-old blueliner got off to a strong start to the season with a goal, seven points, 12 shots on net, five hits and 10 blocked shots over nine appearances. If he's ultimately given the green light, he'll likely rejoin the team's second defensive pairing, where he should continue to be a relevant fantasy asset in deep leagues this season.
4063401.name: Samuel Girard
4063401.short: Girard (undisclosed) is considered a game-time decision for Thursday's home game against the Mammoth, per Seth Rorabaugh of Tribune-Review Sports.

4063569.long: MacEwen was held out of practice Wednesday after suffering his wrist injury during Tuesday's 6-3 loss to Colorado. Prior to sustaining the injury, the 30-year-old forward posted two goals, four points, 26 PIM, 15 shots on net and 35 hits over 14 appearances this season. If MacEwen ultimately can't go Thursday, the newly called-up Brendan Brisson would likely draw into the lineup on the fourth line.
4063569.name: Zack MacEwen
4063569.short: MacEwen (wrist) is a game-time decision for Thursday's home clash against the Wild, per Andre Leal of The Hockey News.

4063605.long: Brazeau is currently considered week-to-week while recovering from the lower-body injury he sustained in the preseason. The 28-year-old winger is coming off a career year, where he posted 17 goals, 34 points, 104 shots on net, 90 hits and 44 blocked shots across 64 regular-season outings. When he recovers, he'll likely factor into the Penguins' bottom six on a somewhat regular basis.
4063605.name: Justin Brazeau
4063605.short: Brazeau (lower body) was placed on injured reserve by the Penguins on Sunday.

4065019.long: Hagel was expected to miss a second consecutive game Thursday against the Oilers, and his placement on injured reserve means that he'll also be sidelined for Sunday's game against the Sabres. He was previously considered day-to-day due to his lower-body injury, so it's possible that he's in the mix to return Wednesday against the Hurricanes, but Jansen Harkins was recalled from AHL Syracuse to provide additional depth in Hagel's absence.
4065019.name: Brandon Hagel
4065019.short: Hagel (lower body) was placed on injured reserve by the Lightning on Thursday, retroactive to Nov. 15, Eduardo A. Encina of the Tampa Bay Times reports.

4233536.long: Heiskanen rotated into drills during Saturday's practice, but he will likely miss his fifth straight game against the Panthers on Sunday. He has already been ruled out for Saturday's matchup against Buffalo. Heiskanen has three goals, 11 points, 26 shots on net, 17 blocked shots and four hits in 15 appearances this season.
4233536.name: Miro Heiskanen
4233536.short: Heiskanen (upper body) is doubtful for Sunday's matchup against Florida, per Mike Heika of the Stars' official site.

4233563.long: Makar being cleared for practice doesn't guarantee he'll be ready to play versus the Habs on Wednesday, but the fact that he was skating with a regular partner in Brett Kulak could be a good indication. In order to suit up, Makar will need to be activated off injured reserve, which will be the final step in his return-to-play process.
4233563.name: Cale Makar
4233563.short: Makar (lower body) was on the ice in a regular sweater ahead of Wednesday's clash with Montreal, Evan Rawal of the Denver Gazette reports.

4233566.long: Pettersson has already been ruled out for Saturday's matchup against Minnesota, and the Canucks will be cautious with the 28-year-old forward. It's still unclear when he will be ready to return. Pettersson has provided six goals, 23 points, 30 shots on net, 32 blocked shots and 41 hits in 24 appearances this season.
4233566.name: Elias Pettersson
4233566.short: Pettersson (upper body) isn't expected to play against Chicago on Sunday, per Canucks play-by-play announcer Brendan Batchelor.

4233594.long: Suzuki hasn't played since Oct. 20 due to the injury, but it sounds like he's day-to-day at this point. The 27-year-old has five goals and 12 points in nine appearances in 2026-27. Suzuki might serve on the top line if he's ready to return Thursday, which would presumably push Alex Newhook out of the first unit and into a middle-six role.
4233594.name: Nick Suzuki
4233594.short: Suzuki (hand) is questionable for Thursday's game against Utah, per Stu Cowan of The Montreal Gazette.

4233627.long: Norris could be facing an absence depending on further tests. The 27-year-old will be at risk of missing Saturday's game versus the Canadiens at a minimum. If Jiri Kulich (undisclosed) is also out, Tyson Kovak would likely draw into the Sabres' lineup.
4233627.name: Josh Norris
4233627.short: Norris entered concussion protocol Thursday after sustaining the injury versus the Maple Leafs, Bill Hoppe of the Olean Times Herald reports.

4233643.long: Chytil will still need to be activated off injured reserve before he can play, but things seem to be trending in that direction for the 27-year-old center. Injuries have limited the Czech to just seven outings this year, in which he generated two assists, 13 shots and six blocks while averaging 19:53 of ice time. In addition to slotting into a top-six role, Chytil should reclaim a spot on one of the power-play units.
4233643.name: Filip Chytil
4233643.short: Chytil (shoulder) looks set to return to the lineup against the Rangers on Friday, Jeff Paterson of CanucksArmy.com reports.

4233648.long: Yamamoto is poised to miss his fourth straight game against Ottawa on Saturday. He is day-to-day, but it's unclear when he will be ready to return. Yamamoto has three goals, seven points, 21 shots on net and 18 hits in nine appearances this season.
4233648.name: Kailer Yamamoto
4233648.short: Yamamoto (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Friday.

4233668.long: Poehling is on long-term injured reserve, but he is eligible to be activated at any time. He's still expected to be out until early December, though he may beat that timeline by a small margin if his recovery continues to go well.
4233668.name: Ryan Poehling
4233668.short: Poehling (knee) is on the Ducks' current road trip and has resumed skating, Derek Lee of The Hockey News reports Thursday.

4233685.long: Frost skated with the team during Wednesday's morning skate, but he's considered day-to-day after exiting Monday's loss to the Senators following a hard hit in the second period. Ben Jones will likely enter the lineup after being called up earlier Wednesday, while Frost's next opportunity to return will be Friday against New Jersey.
4233685.name: Morgan Frost
4233685.short: Frost (upper body) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Penguins, Eric Francis of Sportsnet reports.

4233720.long: Tolvanen also missed last Friday's practice while tending to a personal matter, but his previous absence from practice didn't force him to miss any games. It's not yet clear whether Friday's lack of participation will impact his status for Sunday's game against the Oilers, but a better idea of his availability could come into focus based on whether he's on the ice for the Rangers' morning skate ahead of the game.
4233720.name: Eeli Tolvanen
4233720.short: Tolvanen didn't participate in Friday's practice session due to personal reasons, Vince Z. Mercogliano of The Athletic reports.

4233868.long: After getting hurt in Saturday's preseason finale against Pittsburgh, Timmins is on injured reserve for the beginning of the 2026-27 campaign. He registered eight assists, 44 shots on goal, 81 blocked shots and 29 hits in 39 regular-season appearances with Buffalo in 2025-26.
4233868.name: Conor Timmins
4233868.short: Timmins (lower body) doesn't have a timeline for his return yet, according to Heather Engel of NHL.com on Tuesday.

4233890.long: It's a step in the right direction for Gadjovich, who hasn't played since Oct. 25, 2025, against the Golden Knights, missing over a year of action. Given his extended layoff, the winger's return to practice doesn't mean he will be returning soon. Still, Gadjovich should slot into a bottom-six role for the club once given the all-clear.
4233890.name: Jonah Gadjovich
4233890.short: Gadjovich (neck) took the ice Thursday in a non-contact sweater, George Richards of Florida Hockey Now reports.

4270820.long: After the Sharks stated that Barre-Boulet was day-to-day for an undisclosed injury Wednesday, the issue has been deemed to warrant a stint on IR. The 29-year-old forward was efficient with AHL Colorado in 2025-26, where he posted 26 goals and 70 points across 70 regular-season games. While he's expected to play primarily with AHL San Jose in 2026-27, the six-year veteran could play a couple of stints at the NHL level if the team's center depth experiences any injuries.
4270820.name: Alex Barre-Boulet
4270820.short: Barre-Boulet (undisclosed) will begin the 2026-27 regular season on injured reserve, per Curtis Pashelka of The San Jose Mercury News.

4271998.long: Lindgren has missed the Kraken's last 13 contests due to his upper-body problem, while being held off the scoresheet in his four appearances. If the 28-year-old blueliner does suit up against the Hurricanes, it will likely be in a third-pairing role that doesn't come with power-play opportunities. As such, fantasy managers probably shouldn't be expecting a ton of offensive output from Lindgren.
4271998.name: Ryan Lindgren
4271998.short: Lindgren (upper body) will be a game-time decision ahead of Saturday's matchup with Carolina, Tom Gulitti of NHL.com reports.

4272674.long: Gustavsson will see his first action since May 5 against the Avalanche in the playoffs last year. Look for the netminder to start at least one of two games against AHL San Diego on Friday and Saturday, if not both contests. Once given the all-clear, Gustavsson will likely slot into the No. 2 role behind Jesper Wallstedt, which could see Calvin Pickard shifted to the minors.
4272674.name: Filip Gustavsson
4272674.short: Gustavsson (hip) was reassigned to AHL Iowa on a conditioning assignment Thursday.

4272888.long: Thompson was the first goalie off during Wednesday's morning skate, but he remains on injured reserve due to his lower-body issue ahead of the matchup. Head coach Spencer Carbery said after morning skate that the team will see how Thompson feels Wednesday afternoon before determining his status against Philadelphia. If Thompson remains sidelined Wednesday, Charlie Lindgren or Mitchell Gibson will likely start in the crease.
4272888.name: Logan Thompson
4272888.short: Thompson (lower body) is considered a game-time decision for Wednesday's home game against the Flyers, Sammi Silber of The District Standard reports.

4294163.long: Dahlin would be making his first appearance since Oct. 12 versus the Panthers, a stretch of three games on the shelf due to his upper-body problem. Prior to getting hurt, the 26-year-old blueliner registered two goals and two assists, including a pair of power-play points, in six contests.
4294163.name: Rasmus Dahlin
4294163.short: Dahlin (upper body) told reporters he "thinks he'll be ready" for Wednesday's clash with Philadelphia.

4320548.long: A timeline for Hughes' return remains unclear, but he won't play against Vancouver on Saturday and will miss Monday's matchup against San Jose. He has posted eight goals, 34 points, 63 shots on net and 19 blocked shots in 24 appearances this season.
4320548.name: Quinn Hughes
4320548.short: Hughes (upper body) will miss the rest of Minnesota's road trip, per Joe Smith of The Athletic on Saturday.

4320625.long: While Sturm will travel with the team on its lengthy road trip, it wasn't revealed when he will be able to return to the lineup. The 31-year-old has missed the past two games due to his concussion and is currently on injured reserve.
4320625.name: Nico Sturm
4320625.short: Sturm (concussion) will be with the team on its upcoming five-game road trip, per Michael Russo of The Athletic on Sunday.

4329962.long: The Sharks announced in mid-September that Keyser was facing a long-term absence due to an upper-body injury, so his placement on non-roster injured reserve isn't particularly surprising. Once he's cleared to return, the 27-year-old will likely report to AHL San Jose.
4329962.name: Kyle Keyser
4329962.short: Keyser (upper body) was placed on non-roster injured reserve by the Sharks on Monday, Curtis Pashelka of The San Jose Mercury News reports.

4331611.long: Regula continues to work his way back from offseason surgery that caused him to miss the entire preseason. With the shift to LTIR, the 26-year-old defenseman can be expected to miss at least the next nine games, having already been out of action for one, though it could be longer, considering the team hasn't provided a specific update.
4331611.name: Alec Regula
4331611.short: Regula (undisclosed) was designated for long-term injured reserve Thursday.

4352803.long: Sandin still seems unlikely to suit up versus the Flyers on Wednesday, considering he has just started taking contact, but he hasn't been officially ruled out. IN 73 regular-season games last year, the 23-year-old blueliner notched five goals and 24 assists, just missing the 30-point threshold. Given his extended layoff, Sandin will face an uphill battle to get to 30 points this season as well.
4352803.name: Rasmus Sandin
4352803.short: Sandin (knee) has been cleared to start taking contact, Sammi Silber of The District Standard reports Tuesday.

4352804.long: Although Veleno didn't participate in practice Friday, it was encouraging to see him on the ice ahead of the session. The 26-year-old has been on long-term injured reserve since early October, and he was initially expected to miss approximately three months, so it wouldn't be surprising to see the Rangers bring him along slowly as he continues his recovery process.
4352804.name: Joe Veleno
4352804.short: Veleno (lower body) skated on his own before Friday's practice session, Colin Stephenson of Newsday reports.

4378656.long: Samuelsson took a maintenance day Monday but was on the ice for Wednesday's optional morning skate. While his participation in morning skate was encouraging, the Sabres will monitor how Samuelsson feels in the hours leading up to Wednesday's puck drop before determining his status. If Samuelsson is unavailable against the Rangers, Zach Metsa will likely draw into the lineup.
4378656.name: Mattias Samuelsson
4378656.short: Samuelsson (undisclosed) is considered a game-time decision for Wednesday's matchup against the Rangers, Paul Hamilton of WGR Sports Radio 550 reports.

4378683.long: Durzi has been sidelined since late October due to his lower-body injury but has been skating in a regular sweater recently. The Rangers will presumably see how the defenseman feels in the hours leading up to Sunday's matchup before determining whether to activate him off injured reserve. Across his 14 appearances prior to his absence, Durzi recorded two goals, three assists, 21 blocked shots, 15 PIM and nine hits while averaging 19:52 of ice time.
4378683.name: Sean Durzi
4378683.short: Durzi (lower body) will likely be a game-time decision for Sunday's matchup against the Hurricanes, Jim Cerny of NHL.com reports.

4378686.long: Bahl suffered the injury in pregame warmups before Friday's 5-3 loss to Anaheim. He will finish the 2026-27 campaign with one goal, one assist, 12 shots on net, 16 blocked shots and 22 hits in 16 appearances. The Flames placed Bahl on injured reserve before Sunday's matchup against Philadelphia and recalled Brayden Pachal from AHL Calgary.
4378686.name: Kevin Bahl
4378686.short: Bahl will undergo surgery for a ruptured Achilles tendon and won't play again in the 2026-27 season, the Flames announced Sunday.

4391255.long: In a corresponding move, the Sharks recalled Libor Hajek from AHL San Jose on Monday. Sherwood is week-to-week and has missed the last two games with an upper-body injury. He has contributed two goals, eight points, 40 shots on net and 115 hits in 23 appearances this season.
4391255.name: Kiefer Sherwood
4391255.short: Sherwood (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Monday.

4392072.long: Tippett will miss his second straight game against Colorado on Monday due to an upper-body injury, and he won't be eligible to play against Buffalo on Wednesday. However, it's unclear when he will be available to return. Tippett has contributed one goal, two points, 21 shots on net and 23 hits in nine appearances this season.
4392072.name: Owen Tippett
4392072.short: Tippett (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Monday, per the NHL media site.

4392260.long: Desharnais has been upgraded to day-to-day after fully participating in Tuesday's practice session, but he skated with the scratches during Wednesday's morning skate, signaling that he'll be unavailable for a 13th consecutive game. The 30-year-old's next opportunity to return to game action will be Friday against the Panthers.
4392260.name: Vincent Desharnais
4392260.short: Desharnais (appendectomy) is slated to miss Wednesday's game against the Flyers, Tarik El-Bashir of Monumental Sports Network reports.

4392883.long: After leaving Saturday's 4-3 overtime loss to Chicago late in the second period with an upper-body injury, Pospisil won't play against Ottawa on Monday. It's unclear when he will be ready to return, but he could be out for a while. Pospisil has a concussion history, and the Flames may take a cautious approach with his recovery.
4392883.name: Martin Pospisil
4392883.short: Pospisil (upper body) didn't travel with his teammates for the start of Calgary's five-game road trip, per Eric Francis of Sportsnet on Monday.

4393049.long: Evans sustained his hand injury during Monday's practice. If the 30-year-old winger can't go, the Canadiens announced that Florian Xhekaj will dress for warm-ups and take Evans' place in the lineup. Prior to suffering the hand injury, Evans posted two goals, six points, a plus-4 rating, 13 shots on net, 14 hits and 10 blocked shots across 17 games this season.
4393049.name: Jake Evans
4393049.short: Evans (hand) is expected to be a game-time decision for Tuesday's home clash against the Wild, per Eric Engels of Sportsnet.

4419679.long: Koepke initially appeared to be a healthy scratch, but he is dealing with an injury. The 28-year-old forward has earned one goal, eight shots on net, eight blocked shots and 23 hits in 11 appearances this season.
4419679.name: Cole Koepke
4419679.short: Koepke (undisclosed) was unavailable for Sunday's game against Carolina, according to Mike McIntyre of the Winnipeg Free Press.

4419778.long: After Rifai left Thursday's morning skate, head coach Jim Hiller stated that the 28-year-old blueliner is "dealing with something" and is going to be a game-time decision Thursday. Overall, Rifai has compiled a goal, two PIM, two shots on net and seven blocked shots across two appearances. If he can't go Thursday, Nick Blankenburg is expected to take Rifai's spot on the third pairing alongside Oliver Ekman-Larsson.
4419778.name: Marshall Rifai
4419778.short: Rifai (undisclosed) will be a game-time decision for Thursday's home clash against the Rangers, per Luke Fox of Sportsnet.

4565224.long: Dach also missed Saturday's 5-4 win over Pittsburgh due to an illness. His absence from Monday's skate doesn't bode well for his availability for Tuesday's matchup against Winnipeg, but he still has some time to recover. Dach has earned three assists, eight shots on net, six blocked shots and 18 hits in 13 appearances this season.
4565224.name: Kirby Dach
4565224.short: Dach (illness) won't participate in Monday's practice.

4565225.long: Byram was previously ruled out for Saturday's matchup against Calgary, and he won't be available for Sunday's matchup against Vancouver. It's also doubtful that he will join the team for Wednesday's contest against Seattle. It remains unclear when he will be ready to return.
4565225.name: Bowen Byram
4565225.short: Byram (upper body) didn't accompany his teammates on Chicago's three-game road trip, per Mark Lazerus of The Athletic on Saturday.

4565226.long: Turcotte's day-to-day status doesn't guarantee he'll be in action versus the Penguins on Saturday, but it is certainly a step in the right direction. In three games this season, the 25-year-old center recorded just one shot to go with one assist, four hits and one block. Considering the Illinois native has never played more than 70 games in a season and has failed to reach the 30-point threshold in his career, fantasy managers may not be too worried about his return-to-play timeline.
4565226.name: Alex Turcotte
4565226.short: Turcotte (undisclosed) has been upgraded to day-to-day according to head coach Peter Laviolette, per Zach Dooley of the Kings' official site on Friday.

4565229.long: Broberg didn't participate in Sunday's practice after getting injured in Saturday's 4-1 loss to Florida. He has contributed four goals, 13 points, 42 shots on net and 25 blocked shots in 20 appearances this season. If Broberg is unavailable for Tuesday's matchup against Anaheim, Calle Rosen could make his 2026-27 NHL season debut.
4565229.name: Philip Broberg
4565229.short: Broberg (lower body) is day-to-day, according to Lou Korac of NHL.com on Sunday.

4565235.long: York participated in Friday's practice session, and while it's not yet clear whether he'll be available to return to game action a day later, he seems to be trending in the right direction. A better idea of his status for Saturday's matchup could come into focus based on his participation in the Flyers' morning skate, but if York is held out against Anaheim, his next opportunity to return would be Tuesday against the Blue Jackets.
4565235.name: Cam York
4565235.short: Head coach Rick Tocchet said Friday that he isn't sure whether York (upper body) will be able to suit up Saturday against the Ducks, Jordan Hall of NBC Sports Philadelphia reports.

4565246.long: McMichael skated before Tuesday's practice, but he didn't join his teammates for the main on-ice session. He will likely miss his third straight game with a lower-body injury. He has contributed three goals, 11 points, 32 shots on net and 15 hits in 22 appearances this season.
4565246.name: Connor McMichael
4565246.short: McMichael (lower body) isn't expected to play against the Islanders on Wednesday, according to Lou Korac of NHL.com.

4565259.long: Kochetkov's availability will be closely monitored over the coming days to determine whether or not he'll be in Thursday's lineup against the Canadiens. Overall, the 27-year-old netminder has been lights out with a 12-1-0 record, a 1.62 GAA, two shutouts and a .920 save percentage over 13 appearances this season.
4565259.name: Pyotr Kochetkov
4565259.short: Kochetkov (illness) did not practice on Tuesday, per Walt Ruff of the Hurricanes' official site.

4565270.long: Helleson isn't expected to play Wednesday versus Edmonton or Friday in Winnipeg, but it sounds like he might be an option for Saturday's game in Calgary. Helleson hasn't played this campaign due to the injury. The 25-year-old is likely to serve on the third pairing once he's healthy, possibly at the expense of Noah Warren.
4565270.name: Drew Helleson
4565270.short: Helleson (lower body) hopes to return at the end of Anaheim's upcoming road trip, per Zach Cavanagh of The Sporting Tribune on Wednesday.

4565275.long: Head coach Dan Muse was rather vague when asked about Robertson's availability, so fantasy managers will need to take a wait-and-see approach. If the 25-year-old winger can't give it a go versus the Blues, it would likely mean a return to the lineup for Justin Brazeau or Andrei Kuzmenko.
4565275.name: Nick Robertson
4565275.short: Robertson left Thursday's morning skate early, raising doubts regarding his availability against St. Louis, Seth Rorabaugh of Tribune-Review Sports reports.

4565282.long: The Red Wings indicated earlier in the week that Johansson would likely be able to return to the lineup Wednesday against Boston or Saturday against the Islanders. He'll be unavailable for at least one additional matchup, but it wouldn't be surprising to see him in the mix to suit up Saturday. Across 11 appearances prior to sustaining his injury, Johansson recorded an assist, 12 blocked shots, three hits and two PIM while averaging 15:41 of ice time.
4565282.name: Albert Johansson
4565282.short: Johansson (undisclosed) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Bruins, Ansar Khan of MLive.com reports.

4587568.long: Jenik had nine goals, 17 points and 29 PIM in 43 AHL regular-season outings between Belleville and Ontario in 2025-26. He will probably be sent to the minors once he's recovered from his injury.
4587568.name: Jan Jenik
4587568.short: Jenik (undisclosed) was placed on non-roster injured reserve by Los Angeles on Thursday, per Zach Dooley of LA Kings Insider.

4587580.long: Maccelli wore a red no-contact jersey during the morning skate, and he will miss his ninth straight game against San Jose on Monday. It's still unclear when he will return to the lineup, but he will need to be activated from injured reserve once he receives the green light to play. Maccelli has two goals, six points and 13 shots on net in eight appearances this season.
4587580.name: Matias Maccelli
4587580.short: Maccelli (lower body) is day-to-day, according to Andrew Gross of Newsday on Monday.

4587588.long: Dorofeyev's status against the Sabres and Blackhawks on Wednesday and Friday, respectively, remains up in the air, but the fact that he is making the trip is certainly a step in the right direction. The 26-year-old winger has notched four goals and four assists, including a trio of power-play points, in his last 11 outings. Once given the all-clear, Dorofeyev should reclaim a middle-six role with the Rangers.
4587588.name: Pavel Dorofeyev
4587588.short: Dorofeyev (lower body) will join the Rangers for their two-game road trip, Mollie Walker of the New York Post reports Tuesday.

4587904.long: Based on Tucker's timeline, he shouldn't be expected back until mid-November, though it could certainly be longer. With Logan Mailloux (hand) also sidelined long-term, Adam Jiricek could see an extended run on the blue line. For his part, even once cleared to play, Tucker is unlikely to offer much in the way of fantasy value given his limited offensive upside.
4587904.name: Tyler Tucker
4587904.short: Tucker had arthroscopic knee surgery and will be re-assessed in six weeks, the team announced Wednesday.

4587910.long: Despite being a full participant in Monday's practice, Kiviranta isn't quite ready to return to the lineup. However, he could be an option for Tuesday's rematch against the Avalanche. He has one goal, three shots on net, four hits and one blocked shot in two appearances this season.
4587910.name: Joel Kiviranta
4587910.short: Kiviranta (lower body) won't play against Colorado on Tuesday, according to Owen Newkirk of DLLS Sports.

4587933.long: Kovacevic's ankle issue has been revealed to be a high-ankle sprain, which commonly requires four weeks or more to come back from. Prior to sustaining the injury on Nov. 10 against the Jets, the 29-year-old blueliner posted two points, a plus-2 rating, 10 shots on net, 13 hits and eight blocked shots over 13 appearances. In his absence, Vladislav Kolyachonok, Declan Chisholm and Anton Silaev will be the depth options to fill Kovacevic's role in the lineup.
