4587933.name: Johnathan Kovacevic
4587933.short: Kovacevic (ankle) is expected to be sidelined for 4-6 weeks, per Kristy Flannery of The Hockey News.

4587994.long: Tarasov will be out of action for a second straight game. The 27-year-old's status hasn't been officially updated by the Red Wings, leaving his timeline for a return uncertain, though it is a positive he's not yet on injured reserve. It's unclear at this time if Tarasov will be able to dress for Monday's road-trip finale in Edmonton.
4587994.name: Daniil Tarasov
4587994.short: Tarasov (undisclosed) won't suit up versus the Flames on Saturday.

4587996.long: Marchenko will wear a non-contact jersey during the morning skate, so a return to the lineup against the Blue Jackets on Saturday appears unlikely. He has missed the last 10 games, but seems to be progressing. Marchenko has earned six goals, 14 points, 35 shots on net and 20 hits in 14 appearances this season.
4587996.name: Kirill Marchenko
4587996.short: Marchenko (lower body) is day-to-day, according to David Alter of The Hockey News on Saturday.

4588638.long: Joshua didn't earn a point in four AHL outings with the Marlies. He remains on long-term injured reserve for now, and it's unclear when he will make his NHL season debut.
4588638.name: Dakota Joshua
4588638.short: Joshua (abdomen) was recalled from his conditioning loan with AHL Toronto on Monday.

4697383.long: Byfield left Tuesday's clash against the Capitals after playing just 2:44 of ice time in the 5-2 win. The Kings called up Jared Wright Wednesday in case Byfield can't go, but Head coach Peter Laviolette deemed the transaction a "precautionary move." If the 24-year-old Byfield is given the green light, he'll likely return to his role centering the Kings' second line, where he has compiled a goal, two points and 14 shots on net across seven games this season. He will likely take warm-ups Thursday before a decision is made, so fantasy managers should exercise caution with Byfield rather than leaving him in lineups without a backup plan in place.
4697383.name: Quinton Byfield
4697383.short: Byfield (upper body) will be a game-time decision for Thursday's road clash against the Islanders, per Zach Dooley of the Kings' official site.

4697386.long: Head coach Travis Green said after Monday's 4-1 win over New Jersey that he doesn't think Sanderson or Artem Zub (knee) will be available Tuesday, but he hopes to see the defensemen in the lineup soon. Sanderson will almost certainly slot in on the top pairing and on the No. 1 power-play unit once he moves past his injury.
4697386.name: Jake Sanderson
4697386.short: Sanderson (lower body) is not expected to be an option for Tuesday's home matchup against the Blues, Mike Morreale of NHL.com reports.

4697395.long: Lundell missed Saturday's contest, and he'll likely end up as a game-time decision at best for Sunday. The 25-year-old's potential absence, along with Sandis Vilmanis (undisclosed) being out, leaves the Panthers a bit thin at forward, pending any roster moves.
4697395.name: Anton Lundell
4697395.short: Lundell (undisclosed) is considered questionable to play Sunday versus the Bruins, George Richards of Florida Hockey Now reports.

4697396.long: Jarvis underwent offseason surgery to address a torn labrum and rotator cuff, but he was on the ice during training camp and could be close to making his regular-season debut after missing the first few weeks of the year. The 24-year-old racked up 32 goals, 34 assists, 81 hits, 27 blocked shots and 23 PIM while averaging 18:53 of ice time across 71 regular-season appearances last year.
4697396.name: Seth Jarvis
4697396.short: Jarvis (shoulder) said Friday that he plans to travel with the Hurricanes during their upcoming five-game road trip, Ryan Henkel of The Hockey News reports.

4697404.long: Head coach Dan Muse stated that Chinakhov is once again day-to-day, which set him up to miss his fourth game out of the Penguins' last five outings. Prior to going down, the 25-year-old winger posted two goals, three points, 14 shots on net, four hits and three blockers shots across eight appearances. He'll have some time to rest ahead of his next chance to return to the lineup, which is Thursday's home game against the Mammoth.
4697404.name: Egor Chinakhov
4697404.short: Chinakhov (lower body) will miss Saturday's home clash against the Predators and is still day-to-day, per Seth Rorabaugh.

4697406.long: Foerster got some work in with the Flyers during the morning skate, but he wasn't a full participant, raising doubts regarding his availability Wednesday. The 24-year-old winger is currently mired in a six-game pointless streak and has just one goal in 10 games to start the year. After being limited to just 29 regular-season games last year, there was some hope Foerseter would get back to being a 40-point producer, but that mark could be hard to hit if he doesn't start racking up points soon.
4697406.name: Tyson Foerster
4697406.short: Foerster (hand) will be a game-time decision ahead of Wednesday's clash with Buffalo, Jackie Spiegel of The Philadelphia Inquirer reports.

4697409.long: Neighbours missed Sunday's practice after he logged 16:19 of ice time in Saturday's 4-1 loss to Florida. He has chipped in four goals, nine points, 30 shots on net, 14 blocked shots and 61 hits in 20 appearances this campaign. It's unclear if he will be available for Tuesday's matchup against Anaheim.
4697409.name: Jake Neighbours
4697409.short: Neighbours (upper body) is day-to-day, per Lou Korac of NHL.com on Sunday.

4697411.long: Greig will be unavailable for a second consecutive game due to his lower-body injury, but head coach Travis Green said Friday that the 24-year-old won't be out for an extended period of time. It's not yet clear whether Greig will be available for Tuesday's game against Washington, but he remains day-to-day for now. Sammy Blais will likely remain in the lineup against Utah.
4697411.name: Ridly Greig
4697411.short: Greig (lower body) won't play in Saturday's game against the Mammoth, TSN 1200 Ottawa reports.

4697436.long: Wallinder missed Wednesday's game against the Bruins due to his upper-body injury, but he skated on his own ahead of Thursday's practice. While his status for Saturday isn't yet clear, it at least doesn't appear as though he's facing a long-term absence.
4697436.name: William Wallinder
4697436.short: Head coach Todd McLellan said Thursday that Wallinder (upper body) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Islanders, Helene St. James of the Detroit Free Press reports.

4697446.long: Head coach Sheldon Keefe said after Monday's morning skate that he's optimistic that Evangelista will be able to suit up against Ottawa, but the Devils will still wait to see how he feels in the hours leading up to puck drop. Across his first four starts of the regular season, Evangelista has recorded two goals, an assist, three blocked shots, two PIM and a hit while averaging 18:35 of ice time.
4697446.name: Luke Evangelista
4697446.short: Evangelista is considered a game-time decision for Monday's game against the Senators due to an illness, Kristy Flannery of The Hockey News reports.

4697448.long: Kleven has two goals, three points, eight PIM, 29 hits and 43 blocks in 16 appearances in 2026-27. Carter Yakemchuk is likely to draw back into the lineup because of Kleven's absence.
4697448.name: Tyler Kleven
4697448.short: Kleven (illness) won't play Wednesday in Buffalo, per Jackson Starr of the Senators' official site.

4697449.long: Faber began the regular season on injured reserve after sustaining a fractured skull during the preseason. However, he cleared his return to play protocol in late October and resumed skating with his teammates last week. The 24-year-old is with the Wild on their current road trip, and while he's slated to remain out for Thursday's game in Toronto, he'll likely be able to make his regular-season debut a few days later. Faber recorded 15 goals, 36 assists, 148 blocked shots, 29 PIM and 33 hits while averaging 24:41 of ice time across 80 regular-season appearances with Minnesota last year.
4697449.name: Brock Faber
4697449.short: Faber (skull) has told the Wild that he's ready to play and expects to return for Saturday's game against the Bruins, Michael Russo of The Athletic reports Wednesday.

4697717.long: Kaiser won't be eligible to return until Chicago hosts Minnesota on Nov. 29. He has contributed two goals, five assists, 19 shots on net, 30 blocked shots and 20 hits in 23 appearances this season. With Kaiser unavailable, Kevin Korchinski will likely play against Vancouver on Sunday.
4697717.name: Wyatt Kaiser
4697717.short: Kaiser was suspended for three games by the NHL Department of Player Safety on Sunday for an illegal check to the head against Calgary's Martin Pospisil (upper body) on Saturday.

4697783.long: Sourdif didn't practice Friday due to his illness, and it's unclear whether the issue will impact his availability against New Jersey on Saturday. Pierre-Luc Dubois (illness) has already been ruled out for Saturday's matchup, so Ethen Frank will likely see playing time for the Capitals if Sourdif is sidelined. Regardless of Sourdif's status for Saturday's matchup, it's at least encouraging that the 24-year-old doesn't appear to be facing a long-term absence.
4697783.name: Justin Sourdif
4697783.short: Head coach Spencer Carbery said Friday that Sourdif (illness) is considered day-to-day, Sammi Silber of The Hockey News reports.

4712021.long: While Zub more than likely won't play in Tuesday's game, he appears to be nearing a return to game action. The right-shot blueliner has been skating, and head coach Travis Green relayed after Monday's 4-1 win over New Jersey that he hopes to see Zub in the lineup soon. The 31-year-old Zub will eventually fill an important top-four role for the Senators, who are cruising to begin the season with a 5-1-0 record.
4712021.name: Artem Zub
4712021.short: Zub (knee) is slated to remain sidelined against the Blues on Tuesday, per Mike Morreale of NHL.com.

4755684.long: Caulfield will remain with his family for a while longer after leaving the Ducks' road trip for the birth of his child. At this point, it seems doubtful he'll be available for Saturday's game versus the Flyers, but he could be back in action Tuesday versus the Canucks once the Ducks have returned home.
4755684.name: Judd Caulfield
4755684.short: Caulfield (personal) remains in Southern California and won't play Thursday versus the Devils, Zach Cavanagh of The Sporting Tribune reports. Per the NHL media site, Caulfield has also been designated a non-roster player.

4781550.long: Blankenburg is expected to participate in Saturday's morning skate, but it's unclear when he will be ready to return to the lineup. He is currently on injured reserve and hasn't played since Oct. 22. Blankenburg has one goal, six shots on net, six hits and two blocked shots in six appearances this campaign.
4781550.name: Nick Blankenburg
4781550.short: Blankenburg (upper body) is day-to-day, according to David Alter of The Hockey News on Saturday.

4874720.long: Edvinsson is continuing to hold out for a new contract as a restricted free agent, with no clear end in sight. It's possible a trade materializes at some point, though he would still need to agree to terms on a new contract with a different NHL club. Last season, Edvinsson recorded nine goals and 16 assists in 72 regular-season contests.
4874720.name: Simon Edvinsson
4874720.short: Edvinsson (contract dispute) is on the Red Wings' injured, non-roster list, per the NHL media site Wednesday.

4874721.long: Eklund's timeline would seem to indicate that he will be out of action until the calendar flips to 2027, though it's possible he makes a late-December return if on the early side of his timeline. While the 24-year-old winger is already on injured reserve, he could be a candidate for long-term injured reserve if the Senators need the cap space to make a move.
4874721.name: William Eklund
4874721.short: Eklund had surgery to repair a torn ankle tendon and will be out 10-12 weeks, Bruce Garrioch of Postmedia reports Thursday.

4874723.long: Guenther has been on injured reserve since Nov. 11 and will be unavailable for a seventh consecutive game Monday. However, the Mammoth indicated Saturday that he's now considered day-to-day, and that remains the case ahead of Monday's matchup against Winnipeg. It's not yet clear whether he'll be in the mix to return Wednesday against the Wild, but he appears to be trending in the right direction.
4874723.name: Dylan Guenther
4874723.short: Guenther (upper body) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Jets, Ken Wiebe of The Winnipeg Free Press reports.

4874731.long: Rosen didn't practice Friday due to an undisclosed injury, and he'll be unavailable for at least one matchup. Nino Niederreiter will take his place in the lineup against Chicago, while Rosen's next opportunity to suit up will be Tuesday against Ottawa, though it isn't yet clear whether he'll be able to do so.
4874731.name: Isak Rosen
4874731.short: Rosen (undisclosed) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Blackhawks, Ken Wiebe of The Winnipeg Free Press reports.

4874733.long: Othmann is set to miss his fifth consecutive contest due to his upper-body injury. Prior to his absence, the 23-year-old winger was still looking for his first point of the season, having been left off the scoresheet in all six of his appearances. Even when healthy, Othmann is far from a lock to be in the lineup, and could serve as a healthy scratch periodically.
4874733.name: Brennan Othmann
4874733.short: Othmann (upper body) is not expected to be back in the lineup versus the Ducks on Friday, Pat Steinberg of QR Calgary 770 AM reports.

4874734.long: Bolduc will continue to be evaluated, but at this point, it's no guarantee he'll be available for Thursday's contest versus the Hurricanes. If the 23-year-old has to miss time, Florian Xhekaj will likely get back into the lineup.
4874734.name: Zack Bolduc
4874734.short: Bolduc sustained an upper-body injury Wednesday versus the Devils, and the severity remains unknown, Eric Engels of Sportsnet reports.

4874740.long: Johnston has already been ruled out versus the Avs on Wednesday due to his illness, with Joel Kiviranta (lower body) rejoining the lineup in Johnston's stead. The 23-year-old center has yet to find the back of the net in five outings so far this year, though he has racked up four helpers, including one with the man advantage.
4874740.name: Wyatt Johnston
4874740.short: Johnston (illness) is hoping to be available for Saturday's matchup with Chicago, Lia Assimakopoulos of The Dallas Morning News reports.

4874748.long: Mailloux began his conditioning assignment Monday, and he didn't end up playing in any AHL games. The 23-year-old hasn't been activated off injured reserve, so he might not be ready to return yet. Mailloux might serve on St. Louis' third pairing once he's healthy.
4874748.name: Logan Mailloux
4874748.short: Mailloux (hand) has completed his conditioning assignment with AHL Springfield and rejoined the Blues, the team announced Friday.

4874911.long: Koivunen is considered day-to-day due to his injury, but he'll be sidelined for the first time since Oct. 10. He had recorded a goal, two assists, four PIM and three blocked shots while averaging 14:21 of ice time across his last seven appearances. Andrei Kuzmenko and Rutger McGroarty are candidates to enter the lineup against Anaheim, while Koivunen's next opportunity to suit up will be Wednesday in San Jose.
4874911.name: Ville Koivunen
4874911.short: Koivunen has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Ducks due to a lower-body injury.

4874940.long: Dach also sat out Saturday's 4-2 win over Vancouver due to an illness. He has contributed three goals, one assist, 28 shots on net, 29 hits and eight blocked shots in 13 appearances this season.
4874940.name: Colton Dach
4874940.short: Dach (illness) won't play against the Rangers on Monday.

4894355.long: Danforth's move to IR allowed the Sabres to activate Sam Carrick (middle body) ahead of Thursday's game versus the Ducks. Danforth remains without a clear timeline to return to action. He will miss his fourth straight game Thursday and will be eligible to return whenever ready, as long as he doesn't later end up on long-term injured reserve.
4894355.name: Justin Danforth
4894355.short: Danforth (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Thursday, per the NHL media site.

4894398.long: Back has an assist, five hits and nine blocks in seven appearances this season. While he's not expected to play Thursday in Vegas, perhaps he'll be an option Sunday versus Pittsburgh or Wednesday against Nashville.
4894398.name: Oskar Back
4894398.short: Back (finger) is expected to return within the next week, Robert Tiffin of NHL.com reports Thursday.

4894487.long: Levi landed on injured reserve Friday after reportedly sustaining an injury during Thursday's 6-5 loss to the Hurricanes. Prior to going down, the 24-year-old netminder posted a 6-1-0 record, a 3.11 GAA and an .887 save percentage across seven appearances. In his absence, Tristan Jarry is poised to serve as the lead netminder. Given Levi's current injury timetable, he is expected to rejoin the Oilers' lineup roughly in mid-November.
4894487.name: Devon Levi
4894487.short: Levi (undisclosed) is expected to miss a few weeks, per Jason Gregor of Sports 1440 Edmonton.

4894747.long: Melanson has been out of the lineup since the season opener against Calgary on Oct. 1, a stretch of 16 games on the shelf. Once given the all-clear, Melanson will likely be in line for a bottom-six role, but he is far from a lock on a nightly basis and could find himself in the press box periodically as a healthy scratch.
4894747.name: Jacob Melanson
4894747.short: Melanson (chest) will be a game-time call for Saturday's clash with the Hurricanes, Tom Gulitti of NHL.com reports.

4895527.long: Kozak was revealed to have picked up an undisclosed injury in Saturday's 4-3 loss to the Panthers, and it ultimately kept him out of the lineup Sunday against Tampa Bay. Because he's considered day-to-day, he's currently considered questionable to play in Wednesday's clash against the Rangers. Prior to going down, the 23-year-old center posted a goal, four points, six shots on net, 19 hits and eight blocked shots over 15 outings this season.
4895527.name: Tyson Kozak
4895527.short: Kozak (undisclosed) did not practice Tuesday and is considered day-to-day, per Paul Hamilton of WGR Sports Radio 550.

4915850.long: After agreeing to a one-year, $3 million contract with the Hurricanes on Sunday, Nikishin hasn't joined the team yet. Head coach Rod Brind'Amour told reporters Monday that Nikishin will need a "mini training camp" to get up to speed. It's unclear when the 25-year-old Nikishin will be available to play. He registered 11 goals, 33 points, 33 PIM, 132 hits and 94 blocked shots in 81 regular-season appearances with Carolina in 2025-26.
4915850.name: Alexander Nikishin
4915850.short: Nikishin (not injury related) will need some time before he makes his 2026-27 debut, according to Cory Lavalette of the North State Journal on Monday.

5052.long: Head coach Glen Gulutzan mentioned that if Myers can't play on Wednesday, then the 36-year-old blueliner will likely make his return Friday against the Blues. Myers has been sidelined for each of Dallas' past three games due to an upper-body issue. When healthy, he's posted two points, 13 shots on net, 17 hits and 36 blocked shots over 20 appearances this season. If he can't go Wednesday, Kyle Burroughs will likely remain in the lineup.
5052.name: Tyler Myers
5052.short: Myers (upper body) has a chance to return in Wednesday's home clash against the Predators, per Robert Tiffin of NHL.com.

5075840.long: Pittsburgh moved Soderblom to injured reserve Wednesday, and he has already missed the last two games. It's unclear when he will be ready to return to the lineup. Soderblom has contributed one assist, five shots on net, four blocked shots and 15 hits in six appearances this season.
5075840.name: Elmer Soderblom
5075840.short: Soderblom (upper body) is week-to-week, per Penguins PR on Monday.

5079.long: Spurgeon has missed seven of the Wild's last 11 games due to injury, and will likely be out of action for at least two more due to his lower-body problem. During those four appearances, the veteran blueliner failed to register a point while producing six shots, five blocks and three hits.
5079.name: Jared Spurgeon
5079.short: Spurgeon (lower body) is expected to travel with the team for its upcoming three-game road trip starting Tuesday against Montreal, Joe Smith of The Athletic reports.

5080143.long: Cooley is set to miss his second straight match. He is considered day-to-day, but the 22-year-old needs to undergo further evaluation. Cooley has 11 goals and 21 points in 18 appearances with Utah in 2026-27. If the evaluation process yields encouraging results, and he remains day-to-day, then there might still be a chance of him playing Saturday versus San Jose.
5080143.name: Logan Cooley
5080143.short: Cooley (upper body) will miss Thursday's game against St. Louis, per Cole Bagley of KSL Sports.

5080145.long: Gauthier continues to be classified as day-to-day, so it's possible he'll be ready to face the Bruins on Friday. With the 22-year-old winger on the shelf, Roger McQueen will make his NHL debut against the Flames. For his part, Gauthier is currently mired in a three-game pointless streak and will no doubt be eager to score whenever he's cleared to return.
5080145.name: Cutter Gauthier
5080145.short: Gauthier (upper body) will not be in the lineup versus Calgary on Tuesday, Eric Francis of Sportsnet reports.

5080152.long: Kasper has been on injured reserve due to his upper-body injury since early October, but he resumed skating in a non-contact jersey last week. While he'll remain sidelined for Thursday's game against the Golden Knights, he'll likely be able to return at some point during the Red Wings' road trip that begins Saturday in Colorado and concludes Nov. 14 in Tampa Bay.
5080152.name: Marco Kasper
5080152.short: Head coach Todd McLellan said Thursday that he expects Kasper (upper body) to return at some point during the Red Wings' upcoming four-game road trip, Max Bultman of The Athletic reports.

5080153.long: By moving Savoie to LTIR, the Oilers will get some cap relief while he is sidelined, as their injuries have started to pile up. The 22-year-old forward logged all 82 regular-season games in his rookie campaign, generating 18 goals and 19 assists, including seven power-play points. Considering Savoie is expected to miss at least the first two weeks of the season, fantasy managers probably shouldn't be expecting him to significantly outperform those numbers in 2026-27.
5080153.name: Matt Savoie
5080153.short: Savoie (lower body) was shifted to long-term injured reserve Thursday.

5080154.long: Mintyukov last played Tuesday against the Islanders, so this move might be retroactive to that date. Travis Mitchell was summoned from AHL San Diego in a corresponding move. Mintyukov had two assists, two PIM, five shots, one hit and 16 blocks in nine appearances before sustaining the injury. Nick Jensen might play regularly during Mintyukov's absence.
5080154.name: Pavel Mintyukov
5080154.short: Mintyukov (lower body) was put on injured reserve Thursday.

5080155.long: Geekie is in line to miss the majority of the 2026-27 campaign following Tuesday's news. It's a tough break for the 22-year-old forward, as he had carved out an everyday role for the Lightning. Prior to going down, he compiled four goals, five points, 27 shots on net, 59 hits and eight blocked shots across 20 appearances. Given his 4-5 month timeline for return, he'll have a chance to return in late March or early April, barring he's not shut down for the year.
5080155.name: Conor Geekie
5080155.short: Geekie (shoulder) underwent surgery Monday and is expected to miss 4-5 months.

5080162.long: Dallas also recalled Kyle Burroughs from AHL Texas on Saturday and moved Kyle Capobianco (leg) to long-term injured reserve. Bichsel is week-to-week after being injured in Thursday's 8-3 loss to Winnipeg. He has one assist, 10 shots on net, 24 blocked shots and 39 hits in 18 appearances this season.
5080162.name: Lian Bichsel
5080162.short: Bichsel (lower body) was placed on injured reserve Saturday.

5080171.long: Snuggerud didn't participate in Tuesday's practice because of a soft-tissue injury. He has heated up, posting four goals and two assists over his current four-game point streak. Snuggerud has registered 14 goals, 20 points, 53 shots on net and 17 hits in 24 appearances this season.
5080171.name: Jimmy Snuggerud
5080171.short: Snuggerud (undisclosed) is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Islanders, per Lou Korac of NHL.com.

5080176.long: Kulich also participated fully in Monday's practice and could be an option against Ottawa on Wednesday. He has missed the last four games while going through concussion protocol.
5080176.name: Jiri Kulich
5080176.short: Kulich (concussion) participated in Tuesday's practice and is close to being ready to return, according to Rachel Lenzi of The Buffalo News.

5080179.long: Howard exited Saturday's 4-0 win over the Islanders after taking a knee-on-knee hit from Emil Heineman. Head coach Mike Babcock is optimistic that Howard's injury isn't serious, but it's unclear when the 22-year-old forward will be ready to return.  Howard has one goal and two assists in 14 appearances this season.
5080179.name: Isaac Howard
5080179.short: Howard (knee) won't play against the Rangers on Sunday, per Stephen Whyno of the Associated Press.

5080203.long: The Sharks announced in mid-September that Lund was expected to miss about a month due to his upper-body injury, so his placement on non-roster injured reserve isn't particularly surprising. Once he's cleared to return to action, he'll likely report to AHL San Jose.
5080203.name: Cam Lund
5080203.short: Lund (upper body) was placed on non-roster injured reserve by the Sharks on Monday, Curtis Pashelka of The San Jose Mercury News reports.

5080212.long: Casey began the season on non-roster injured reserve due to knee surgery. This move to LTIR doesn't change his timeline -- he's already missed enough time to be eligible to return. He was slated to miss 6-8 weeks, so don't expect him to be ready until late November at the earliest.
5080212.name: Seamus Casey
5080212.short: Casey (knee) was moved to long-term injured reserve on Friday, per PuckPedia.

5080221.long: Poitras has four goals and seven points in 12 appearances with Boston in 2026-27. Sean Kuraly is set to draw into the lineup Thursday due to Poitras' absence.
5080221.name: Matthew Poitras
5080221.short: Poitras (nose) won't play Thursday in Pittsburgh, per Kevin Paul Dupont of The Boston Globe.

5080222.long: Leinonen will probably report to AHL Rochester when he's ready to return to game action. He sustained the injury during the offseason.
5080222.name: Topias Leinonen
5080222.short: Leinonen (lower body) was placed on the injured non-roster list Monday.

5080223.long: Salomonsson is away from the team for a personal matter, and it's unclear when he will return. He hasn't earned a point in six NHL appearances this season, but he has 14 shots on net, five blocked shots and seven hits.
5080223.name: Elias Salomonsson
5080223.short: Salomonsson (personal) is out indefinitely, according to Ken Wiebe of The Winnipeg Free Press on Saturday.

5103599.long: Vilmanis will be evaluated ahead of Sunday's game against Boston, but the Panthers may need to wait until they are back in Florida to know about his status. That could rule him out for the final two games of the road trip, which ends in Columbus on Tuesday. If Anton Lundell (undisclosed) and Vilmanis are out against the Bruins on Sunday, Radko Gudas could dress as a seventh defenseman, or the Panthers may bring up a forward from the minors.
5103599.name: Sandis Vilmanis
5103599.short: Vilmanis (undisclosed) will probably miss a few games, according to George Richards of Florida Hockey Now on Saturday.

5103687.long: It wasn't immediately clear when Merkulov was injured or how long he is expected to be on the shelf for. The 25-year-old will probably suit up for AHL Colorado once he's given the green light to appear in a game.
5103687.name: Georgii Merkulov
5103687.short: Merkulov (undisclosed) was put on non-roster injured reserve Monday.

5103825.long: Carlile is day-to-day and will miss at least one game. He has contributed three goals, six points, 28 shots on net, 33 blocked shots and 18 hits in 21 appearances this season. Spencer Stastney will replace Carlile in Sunday's lineup against the Stars.
5103825.name: Declan Carlile
5103825.short: Carlile (lower body) won't play against Dallas on Sunday, per King Jemison of the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette.

5136614.long: Brindley sustained the injury Wednesday versus the Mammoth. The 22-year-old forward won't be able to play until he's cleared the concussion protocol, and even when that happens, he might be reassigned to AHL Colorado to get back up to speed.
5136614.name: Gavin Brindley
5136614.short: Brindley is in concussion protocol and is considered out indefinitely, Bailey Curtis of DNVR Sports reports.

5136696.long: The Maple Leafs moved McWard onto the injured reserve list Friday. He hasn't picked up a point in two NHL outings this season, but he has earned one shot on net, three blocked shots and one hit.
5136696.name: Cole McWard
5136696.short: McWard (lower body) is considered day-to-day, per David Alter of The Hockey News on Saturday.

5149125.long: Bedard and the Blackhawks elected to go the surgical route rather than rehabbing with respect to the 21-year-old's shoulder injury, and his recovery timeline has now come into focus. The 2023 No. 1 overall pick was placed on injured reserve Sunday, which freed up a roster spot for the team. Roman Kantserov has been centering the top line of late, and he looked good in that role with six points over the weekend in games against Calgary and Vancouver, so he could be the biggest beneficiary of Bedard's absence.
5149125.name: Connor Bedard
5149125.short: Bedard underwent successful shoulder surgery Monday and is expected to make a full recovery in approximately four months, the Blackhawks announced.

5149153.long: Carlsson didn't participate in Sunday's practice after getting injured in Saturday's 3-2 loss to Utah. He might not be available for Monday's matchup against Seattle. Carlsson has registered seven goals, 29 points and 41 shots on net in 24 outings this season.
5149153.name: Leo Carlsson
5149153.short: Carlsson (upper body) is day-to-day, according to Eric Stephens of The Athletic on Sunday.

5149180.long: Willander participated in Monday's morning skate, but he skated with the extras and will ultimately be sidelined for a fourth consecutive matchup. However, head coach Manny Malhotra said Monday that Willander is advancing in his recovery. The 21-year-old Willander's next opportunity to return to game action will be Friday against the Rangers.
5149180.name: Tom Willander
5149180.short: Willander (lower body) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Flyers, Canucks play-by-play announcer Brendan Batchelor reports.

5149191.long: Honzek missed Saturday's game against the Ducks due to a previously unspecified injury, but it's now been revealed that he's dealing with a lower-body issue. After being further evaluated, the 21-year-old appears to be facing a multi-game absence. Maxim Tsyplakov will likely continue to see an uptick in playing time while Honzek is sidelined.
5149191.name: Samuel Honzek
5149191.short: The Flames announced Monday that Honzek is considered week-to-week due to a lower-body injury.

5149209.long: Musty suffered an upper-body injury ahead of training camp and was expected to have a long-term absence. He's been on non-roster injured reserve to begin the regular season, and it's not yet clear when he'll be deemed healthy. Once the 21-year-old is cleared to return to game action, he'll presumably be sent to AHL San Jose.
5149209.name: Quentin Musty
5149209.short: Head coach Ryan Warsofsky said Sunday that Musty (upper body) isn't close to returning, Curtis Pashelka of The San Jose Mercury News reports.

5149210.long: Ritchie is currently mired in a five-game pointless streak during which he has generated four blocks, two shots and two PIM while averaging 10:38 of ice time. With the 21-year-old forward sidelined long-term, he likely will be placed on injured reserve in the coming days to free up a roster spot. For now, Mitchell Chaffee could get an extended run at the NHL level with both Ritchie and Matias Maccelli (lower body) dealing with injuries.
5149210.name: Calum Ritchie
5149210.short: Ritchie (lower body) will be out of action for 4-6 weeks, the team announced Monday.

5157.long: Hedman is considered day-to-day at this time. The Lightning are poised to go with six defensemen in the lineup, also scratching Max Crozier. Look for increased duties for Charle-Edouard D'Astous in Saturday's contest.
5157.name: Victor Hedman
5157.short: Hedman (lower body) won't play Saturday versus the Mammoth.

5160.long: Tavares collided with a Sabre and came away worse for wear, leaving the game immediately. The Maple Leafs should know more in the coming days regarding the 36-year-old's status. Toronto hosts the Islanders on Saturday. Tavares had two assists prior to his exit, giving him seven points through seven contests this season.
5160.name: John Tavares
5160.short: Tavares sustained an undisclosed injury in the third period of Thursday's game versus the Sabres, and head coach Jim Hiller had no update on the center's status following the contest, David Alter of The Hockey News reports.

5161.long: The Stars placed Duchene on long-term injured reserve just before the start of the 2026-27 campaign. It remains unclear when he will return, but his new timeline could keep him out until at least mid-January. Duchene posted 16 goals, 45 points and 89 shots on net in 57 regular-season appearances for Dallas in 2025-26.
5161.name: Matt Duchene
5161.short: Duchene will be out for approximately three months after undergoing surgery to repair a core injury, the team announced Monday.

5172.long: The Wild announced Thursday that Foligno would join the team for its upcoming three-game road trip, but he could ultimately return to game action for the final matchup in Minnesota's homestand. The 35-year-old has been sidelined since Oct. 10, and he was held scoreless with 13 hits while averaging 12:10 of ice time across his four appearances prior to his absence.
5172.name: Marcus Foligno
5172.short: Foligno (lower body) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Sharks but could play in Saturday's matchup against the Lightning, Michael Russo of The Athletic reports.

5173105.long: Barkey will miss at least one game, but it's unclear if he will be ready to play against Buffalo on Tuesday. He has earned four goals, 10 points, 19 shots on net and 19 hits in 19 appearances this season. Cole Knuble will replace Barkey in Sunday's lineup against the Oilers.
5173105.name: Denver Barkey
5173105.short: Barkey (illness) won't play against Edmonton on Sunday, per Adam Kimelman of NHL.com.

5174160.long: While it's not clear why Hildeby may not be available, the Bolts did call up Mads Sogaard from the minors just in case. Regardless of Hildeby's status, the Bolts are expected to utilize Andrei Vasilevskiy in the crease versus the Rangers.
5174160.name: Dennis Hildeby
5174160.short: Hildeby is questionable to serve as the backup against the Rangers on Tuesday for an undisclosed reason, Eduardo A. Encina of the Tampa Bay Times reports.

5174232.long: Matinpalo suffered an upper-body injury in Monday's 4-1 win over New Jersey. He hasn't earned a point in six appearances this season, but he has posted four shots on net, eight blocked shots and four hits. Jorian Donovan will replace Matinpalo in Tuesday's lineup against the Blues.
5174232.name: Nikolas Matinpalo
5174232.short: Matinpalo (upper body) won't play against St. Louis on Tuesday, and there is no timeline for his return, Bruce Garrioch of Postmedia reports.

5188457.long: Oliver Kapanen (lower body) was activated from injured reserve in a corresponding move. Xhekaj will sit out his fourth straight game against Buffalo on Saturday. The Canadiens announced Friday that Xhekaj is expected to miss another two weeks.
5188457.name: Florian Xhekaj
5188457.short: Xhekaj (lower body) was placed on injured reserve Saturday, per the NHL media site.

5188490.long: Grebenkin's upper-body injury has been revealed to be an issue with his back, which he has successfully had repaired. The 23-year-old winger is expected to miss the majority of the 2026-27 campaign, but his current timeline for return, barring any setbacks, projects him back sometime after the All-Star break in mid-February. When he does return, Grebenkin will look to build off a positive rookie campaign, where he compiled four goals, 14 points, 32 shots on net, 86 hits and 17 blocked shots across 55 regular-season outings in 2025-26.
5188490.name: Nikita Grebenkin
5188490.short: Grebenkin (back) underwent successful surgery and is expected to miss at least four months.

5188510.long: Kaskimaki's status wasn't updated after the contest. The 22-year-old should be considered day-to-day pending an update from the Blues. Jonatan Berggren would likely enter the lineup if Kaskimaki can't play Tuesday versus the Ducks.
5188510.name: Aleksanteri Kaskimaki
5188510.short: Kaskimaki sustained an undisclosed injury near the end of Saturday's game versus the Panthers, Lou Korac of NHL.com reports.

5188523.long: Moore hasn't made his season debut yet because of the injury. He's expected to miss Wednesday's game in Nashville, but perhaps he'll be an option Saturday versus the Islanders or Sunday against Calgary. Moore had four goals and 12 points in 67 regular-season appearances in 2025-26. He might play on the third pairing once he's healthy.
5188523.name: Ian Moore
5188523.short: Moore (lower body) might be an option to play by the end of the week, Derek Lee of The Hockey News reports Wednesday.

5216858.long: Anaheim recalled Nico Myatovic from AHL San Diego in a corresponding move. Sennecke will miss at least the next three games, starting with Saturday's matchup against Utah, but it's unclear when he will be available to return. He has registered 12 goals, 26 points, 53 shots on net and 19 hits in 22 appearances this season.
5216858.name: Beckett Sennecke
5216858.short: Sennecke (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Saturday.

5216860.long: Montreal will begin a three-game road trip in Colorado on Wednesday, with the final matchup coming in Utah on Nov. 30. Hughes conveyed that Demidov is getting closer to returning to the lineup, though it wasn't made clear if Demidov will meet the team at some point during the road trip. Once he returns to action, he will most likely slot into a top-six role, potentially alongside newcomer Dylan Larkin.
5216860.name: Ivan Demidov
5216860.short: General manager Kent Hughes said Monday that Demidov (ankle) will not travel with the team for Wednesday's game in Colorado, Renaud Lavoie of TVA Sports reports.

5216882.long: Helenius has missed the last two games and didn't participate in Monday's practice. He has contributed one goal, two assists, 12 shots on net, four blocked shots and 11 hits in 11 appearances this season.
5216882.name: Konsta Helenius
5216882.short: Helenius (upper body) is week-to-week, according to Matthew Fairburn of The Athletic on Monday.

5216907.long: Chernyshov remains on injured reserve and has missed the last 11 games after blocking a shot in Ottawa on Oct. 22. While an exact timeline for Chernyshov's return to the lineup hasn't been established, it's probably reasonable to assume that he will be out until sometime in December.
5216907.name: Igor Chernyshov
5216907.short: Head coach Ryan Warsofsky said Sunday that Chernyshov (upper body) is not close to returning to game action, per Curtis Pashelka of The San Jose Mercury News.

5275337.long: Considering Hagens hasn't been cleared for contact yet, fantasy managers probably shouldn't be expecting him back in the lineup versus the Jets on Wednesday. Still, the 20-year-old's return to practice, even in a limited capacity, is a step in the right direction, which should clear the way for Hagens to return sooner rather than later.
5275337.name: James Hagens
5275337.short: Hagens (back) is wearing a non-contact sweater ahead of Tuesday's practice, Steve Conroy of the Boston Herald reports.

5291944.long: O'Brien has been on non-roster injured reserve since the start of the regular season, but he's been with the team in Seattle and has been skating off to the side recently. Despite the 19-year-old's recent on-ice activity, it doesn't appear as though he's particularly close to being cleared for game action.
5291944.name: Jake O'Brien
5291944.short: The Kraken indicated Thursday that O'Brien (lower body) remains week-to-week, Mike Benton of the Kraken Audio Network reports.

5291947.long: Kindel is thankfully feeling like himself a week after from his vasovagal episode. His presence at practice Tuesday indicates that he's feeling much better and could be ready to return in the near future. Prior to the incident, the 19-year-old center had compiled two goals, four points and 23 shots on net across nine games this season. If he continues to progress in his recovery, he'll have a chance to return to the Penguins' lineup in Thursday's clash against the Mammoth.
5291947.name: Ben Kindel
5291947.short: Kindel (vasovagal episode) returned to practice Tuesday and feels normal following his vasovagal episode on Oct. 20, per Wes Crosby of NHL.com.

5334662.long: Smits landed on injured reserve in early November, which has caused him to miss the Rangers' last five games. The 18-year-old blueliner appeared in 17 contests prior to going down, where posted a minus-2 rating, eight shots on net, 16 hits and 10 blocked shots while averaging 14:29 of ice time. Given his current time line, he's expected to return sometime between late January and March. In his absence, Matthew Robertson and Scott Morrow should continue to see depth roles on the blue line.
5334662.name: Alberts Smits
5334662.short: Smits (upper body) is expected to miss 2-3 months, Peter Baugh of The Athletic reported Saturday.

5428.long: Hall hasn't played since Oct. 13 because of the injury. He has three goals and five points in eight appearances in 2026-27. Hall will likely serve in a middle-six capacity if he's ready to play, which might result in Nicolas Deslauriers being a healthy scratch.
5428.name: Taylor Hall
5428.short: Hall (upper body) is expected to be a game-time decision Thursday versus the Islanders, per Brian Compton of NHL.com.

5452.long: Markstrom suffered the injury in Monday's practice after getting hit by a puck. He has posted a 3-1-1 record with one shutout, a 2.21 GAA and an .897 save percentage in six appearances this season. Akira Schmid could see most of the starts for the Panthers until Markstrom returns, but Cooper Black is also expected to see some playing time.
5452.name: Jacob Markstrom
5452.short: Markstrom (undisclosed) will miss 10-14 days, Jameson Olive of the Panthers' official site reports Tuesday.

5474.long: Carrick has only appeared in four of the Sabres' nine games to start the year, so he's far from a lock for the lineup even when healthy. While the team will also be without forward Justin Danforth (upper body), it will get Jason Zucker (abdomen) in the lineup for the first time this year. At this point, Carrick figures to remain a fringe roster piece even after being cleared to play and won't offer much in terms of fantasy value.
5474.name: Sam Carrick
5474.short: Carrick (upper body) will not be in the lineup versus the Flyers on Wednesday, Joe Yerdon of Bleacher Report reports.

5509.long: Hyman will miss his second straight game after leaving Saturday's 7-4 loss to Carolina with a migraine that was affecting his vision. It remains unclear when he will be ready to return. Hyman has earned four goals, six points, 25 shots on net and seven hits in 14 appearances this season.
5509.name: Zach Hyman
5509.short: Hyman (migraine) won't play against Vegas on Tuesday, per Oilers play-by-play announcer Jack Michaels.

5511.long: Niederreiter was injured by teammate Tyrel Bauer's errant stick in the third period. Niederreiter can be considered day-to-day ahead of Sunday's game versus the Canadiens. If he can't play, Cole Koepke will likely draw back into the lineup.
5511.name: Nino Niederreiter
5511.short: Niederreiter left Thursday's game versus the Stars after taking a stick up high, and there was no update on his status after the contest, Robert Tiffin of NHL.com reports.

5560.long: Zuccarello hasn't played since Oct. 24 due to the injury. He has an assist in six appearances in 2026-27. Zuccarello should serve in a top-six role once he's healthy.
5560.name: Mats Zuccarello
5560.short: Zuccarello (upper body) is regarded as week-to-week, Zach Dooley of the Kings' official site reports Thursday.

5592.long: Tanev has been on injured reserve and considered week-to-week since mid-October. While he remains on injured reserve for now, he participated in Wednesday's morning skate in a regular sweater and appears to be closing in on a return. Across his first five appearances of the regular season, the 36-year-old recorded an assist, 14 blocked shots and a hit while averaging 16:51 of ice time.
5592.name: Chris Tanev
5592.short: The Maple Leafs announced Wednesday that Tanev (upper body) has been upgraded to day-to-day, Mark Masters of TSN reports.

5614.long: Gallagher will miss at least the next three games, starting with Saturday's matchup against Minnesota, but it's unclear when he will be ready to return. He has collected three assists, 26 shots on net, eight blocked shots and 32 hits in 21 appearances this campaign.
5614.name: Brendan Gallagher
5614.short: Gallagher (lower body) was placed on injured reserve Saturday.

5774.long: Gustafsson will miss at least the next three games, starting with Monday's matchup against Montreal, after landing on injured reserve. He suffered an upper-body injury in Saturday's 4-2 loss to Ottawa. Gustafsson has two goals, nine points, 16 shots on net and 16 blocked shots in 16 appearances this season.
5774.name: Erik Gustafsson
5774.short: Gustafsson (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Monday, per the NHL media site.

5828.long: Bjugstad underwent surgery to repair a torn left pectoral muscle in September, and he was transferred to long-term injured reserve in early October. The 34-year-old isn't expected to be in the mix to return to game action until at least January, but he'll likely have the chance to compete for a bottom-six role once he's cleared to suit up.
5828.name: Nick Bjugstad
5828.short: Bjugstad (pectoral), Dawson Mercer, Nico Daws, Alexander Command and a pair of draft picks were traded to the Jets from the Devils on Friday in exchange for Connor Hellebuyck.

5831.long: While Granlund has already been ruled out versus the Bruins on Friday, the fact that he will be with the team is certainly good news. The 34-year-old center has registered at least a point in all six games to open the year, compiling two goals and six helpers along the way. With Granlund on the shelf, Roger McQueen figures to get some time in the NHL, though he could be returned to the minors when the veteran is cleared to play.
5831.name: Mikael Granlund
5831.short: Granlund (upper body) will be with the Ducks for their upcoming four-game road trip, Patrick Present of The Hockey News reports Friday.

5833.long: Kreider suffered an injury in Thursday's 5-2 win over Boston, and he is facing an extended absence. He has contributed three goals, nine points, 22 shots on net, eight blocked shots and 21 hits in 19 appearances this season. During Kreider's absence, Florian Xhekaj and Owen Beck could compete for playing time.
5833.name: Chris Kreider
5833.short: Kreider (lower body) will be out for approximately 6-8 weeks, the Canadiens announced Saturday.
